title: Operations Manager
description:
We are a Reddit-focused marketing agency managing Reddit campaigns for home service, SaaS, and finance companies.



We are now looking for a Operations Manager to help handle day-to-day operations.



You will be the “control center” of the company: organizing tasks, managing people and keeping everything running smoothly.



This is a long-term REMOTE role with full ownership, structure, and leadership opportunities.



RESPONSIBILITIES



1) Daily Operations Management



Assign daily tasks to tea
mbers

Manage and optimize workflows

Track deadlines and deliverables

Ensure quality standards are met for all Reddit posts/accounts

Maintain daily/weekly operational dashboards



2) Team Coordination



Reddit Content Creator: content review, scheduling

Reddit Account Creator: account quality & ban-rate control

Ensure both roles follow SOPs and KPIs

Hold daily sync with the founder



3) Quality Assurance



Review Reddit posts before publishing

Check tone, formatting, targeting, and alignment with client goals

Monitor account safety and behavior patterns



4) Analytics & Reporting



Maintain Google Sheets dashboards

Track KPIs, progress, ban rate, karma growth

Prepare weekly reports for the founder

Identify problems early and provide proactive solutions



5) Process Creation



Create SOPs, templates, checklists

Optimize daily operations and automate where possible (basic tools, no coding required)

Skills

Technical & Operational Skills



Strong experience managing daily operations for online or digital businesses

Ability to coordinate multiple tea
mbers (account creators, content creators)

Experience with workflow optimization and creating SOPs

Solid understanding of KPIs, dashboards, and performance tracking

Proficiency with Google Sheets, task management tools (Trello/Notion/ClickUp), and reporting

Ability to monitor quality control across multiple tasks

Strong ability to analyze problems early and create proactive solutions





EXPERIENCE WITH REDDIT IS CRUCIAL





Communication & Leadership



Excellent written and verbal English communication

Ability to lead, motivate, and hold tea
mbers accountable

Strong organizational and time-management skills

Ability to handle client-facing conversations confidently

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision





Soft Skills



High attention to detail

Reliability and consistency in daily operations

Fast learner, problem-solver, and process-driven mindset

Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks under pressure

Strong ownership mentality treats the company’s goals as their own





Bonus Skills



Experience in remote team management

Knowledge of Reddit account warming / safe posting patterns

Basic understanding of digital marketing or content strategy

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:

title: Content creator
description:
I’m looking for an actual skilled video editor, not someone who simply uploads footage into an AI editor and lets it do all the work.



I want someone who understands comedic timing, pacing, transitions, audience retention, and how to make short-form content feel intentional.



The concept is me, a Realtor who previously sold cars, presenting a home like a stereotypical used-car salesman would present a vehicle.



The footage will already be filmed. I need someone who can turn it into a polished, entertaining short-form video.



Editing style



* Clean and fairly stripped down

* Quick transitions from clip to clip

* Low background music that adds energy without overpowering the dialogue

* Tight cuts with little to no dead space

* Good comedic timing

* Occasional zooms, punch-ins, or sound effects where they actually make the joke better

* Captions/subtitles that are clean and easy to read

* Keep the pacing moving throughout the entire video

* The main goal is audience retention and keeping people watching until the final joke



I do not want it overly edited, filled with crazy effects, or made to feel like a traditional luxury real estate video.



It should feel like natural social media content that happens to be professionally edited.



The humor and my personality need to be the focus, while the house is still clearly being showcased.



The finished video will primarily be used for
 Reels, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



When applying, please send examples of short-form content you have personally edited, especially anything involving comedy, personality-driven content, fast pacing, or strong audience retention.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: |

IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.

Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren

title: Marketing Associate
description:
ABOUT IDL

IDL is building the first global professional dance league. Our first season brings together six pro teams, live events, major content moments, ticket on-sales, team announcements, and ecommerce drops for fans who want to support the league and represent their teams.



We are looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to build and run the
 and SMS engine that connects all of those moments.



This role is for someone who is strong at lifecycle marketing execution: campaign calendars, segmentation,
/SMS builds, automated flows, QA, reporting, and weekly optimization. Ecommerce products are part of the business, so you will support merch and product campaigns through lifecycle marketing. You do not need to own Shopify store operations.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own IDL's lifecycle marketing program across the full fan journey.



That means planning and executing campaigns around content drops, roster and team announcements, ticket on-sales, event reminders, merch drops, post-event follow-up, and fan re-engagement. You will build the flows, segments, QA process, and reporting rhythm that make
 and SMS a reliable channel for fan engagement and revenue.



This is a build role, not a maintenance role. IDL has a full season calendar and a growing audience, but the lifecycle program is still early. The right person will turn a busy marketing calendar into clear, well-timed, well-targeted fan communication.



What you'll own:

*Lifecycle campaign calendar

  - Build and maintain the
/SMS calendar across IDL's season.

  - Translate marketing, content, ticketing, event, and ecommerce priorities into clear lifecycle campaigns.  

  - Plan send timing, audience segments, message sequence, and channel mix for each major moment.

  - Coordinate with internal stakeholders so campaigns have the copy, creative, links, offers, and approvals they need before launch.

  - Flag conflicts, gaps, and missing inputs early instead of waiting until the send date.


 and SMS campaign execution

  - Build, schedule, QA, and launch
 campaigns.

  - Build, schedule, QA, and launch SMS campaigns where appropriate.

  - Write or adapt clear lifecycle copy from provided campaign direction.

  - Personalize campaigns by fan behavior, city, ticketing status, team affinity, ecommerce behavior, and engagement level.

  - QA every campaign before launch: links, tracking, discounts or offer logic, audience rules, send time, rendering, and mobile readability.

*Lifecycle flows and automations

  - Build and improve the core lifecycle flows, including:

  - Welcome and onboarding

  - Event city interest

  - Ticket interest and ticket purchase follow-up

  - Event reminder sequence

  - Post-event recap and re-engagement

  - Merch drop awareness and post-purchase follow-up

  - Browse abandon, cart abandon, back-in-stock, and win-back where supported by the tools

  - Monitor flow health and recommend improvements based on performance.

  - Keep flows current as IDL's season, teams, events, and product calendar evolve.

*Segmentation and list health

  - Build and maintain useful audience segments across the fan base.

  - Segment by ticket buyers, event attendees, city interest, team affinity, merch buyers, SMS subscribers, engaged non-purchasers, and lapsed fans.

  - Improve list growth, opt-in capture, engagement, deliverability, and unsubscribe health.

  - Make sure sends are targeted and useful, not generic blasts.

*Ecommerce lifecycle support

  - Support lifecycle campaigns for IDL merch and product drops.

  - Build
/SMS sequences for launches, back-in-stock moments, limited-time offers, team product pushes, and post-purchase engagement.

  - Partner with the ecommerce or merch owner on campaign inputs such as product details, offer logic, inventory constraints, and launch timing.

  - Report on lifecycle contribution to ecommerce revenue, conversion, repeat purchase, and sell-through where data is available.



This role does not need to own Shopify product setup, PDP maintenance, inventory updates, theme edits, checkout QA, or fulfillment operations.

Reporting and optimization

Deliver a weekly lifecycle report with the key numbers and the recommended next actions.

Track campaign performance, flow performance, list growth, SMS opt-ins, deliverability, unsubscribe rates, revenue contribution, ticketing contribution, and ecommerce contribution.

Identify what worked, what did not, and what should change next.

Run practical tests around subject lines, send timing, segmentation, offers, and lifecycle sequencing.



WHAT YOU BRING:

*Must have

  - 3+ years of hands-on lifecycle, CRM,
, SMS, or retention marketing experience.

  - Direct experience building campaigns and flows in Klaviyo or a comparable ESP/SMS platform.

  - Strong campaign calendar discipline across multiple launches, events, or business priorities.

  - Experience with segmentation, automation, QA, campaign reporting, and performance recommendations.

  - Comfortable supporting ecommerce marketing campaigns, especially product drops, limited-time offers, post-purchase flows, or abandoned-cart flows.

  - Strong written English and clean async communication.

  - Detail-oriented QA mindset. You catch broken links, wrong segments, missing tracking, bad timing, and unclear copy before customers do.

  - Able to work US hours from the Philippines, with meaningful overlap with US Pacific Time.

*Nice to have

  - Experience with sports, entertainment, live events, creators, communities, apparel, merch, or fan-driven brands.

  - Experience with ticketing, event reminders, attendance-driving campaigns, or post-event re-engagement.

  - SMS compliance familiarity, including consent, STOP/HELP language, quiet hours, and double opt-in where needed.

  - Basic ecommerce analytics experience across revenue, conversion, AOV, repeat purchase, and sell-through.

  - Basic HTML/CSS for
 cleanup.

  - Working style

 

You are a strong fit if you:

  - Like turning messy calendars into clear campaign plans.

  - Are comfortable asking for missing inputs early.

  - Can operate with direction but do not need daily hand-holding.

  - Think in segments, timing, journeys, and QA checklists.

  - Care about whether fans receive the right message at the right time.

  - Can move fast without being sloppy.

  - Know when to make a recommendation instead of only reporting numbers.



You are probably not a fit if you:



Only want strategy and do not want to build campaigns yourself.

Need someone else to define every step before you can act.

Think lifecycle marketing means sending the same newsletter to everyone.

Are looking for a pure ecommerce operations role.

Are not available for US-hour overlap.



FIRST 90 DAYS:

By the end of the first 90 days, you will have:

  - Mapped IDL's season calendar into a lifecycle campaign calendar.

  - Audited current
/SMS lists, segments, flows, forms, and reporting.

  - Launched or improved the core flows: welcome, event interest, ticket purchase follow-up, event reminder, post-event re-engagement, merch drop support, abandoned cart, and post-purchase.

  - Created a repeatable campaign QA process.

  - Built a weekly lifecycle reporting format.

  - Launched lifecycle campaigns for at least one major content moment, ticketing moment, event moment, and ecommerce product moment.

  - Recommended the next highest-impact lifecycle improvements based on performance data.



LOGISTICS

Location: Philippines-based remote contractor

Schedule: US hours required, with core overlap during US Pacific business hours

Engagement: Full-time contractor

Compensation: [Insert monthly range]

Start date: [Insert target start date]

Tools: Klaviyo or comparable ESP/SMS platform, Shopify data as needed, Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, analytics/reporting tools as available



HOW TO APPLY:

Please send:

Your resume or LinkedIn profile.

A 1 minute intro loom video

A short note on the most relevant lifecycle program you have run.

The ESP/SMS tools you have used hands-on.

Examples of flows or campaigns you have built, with sensitive information removed.

One example of a lifecycle metric you improved and what you changed to improve it.

Your availability for US Pacific Time overlap.

SOCIAL MEDIA + ARTIST OPERATIONS ASSISTANT  

Long-Term Music Industry Opportunity



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



ABOUT THE ROLE



I’m an independent music artist building a long-term creative career, business, and team, and I’m looking for someone reliable, organized, resourceful, and ambitious who would be excited to grow alongside it.



The job will start simple.



Initially, you’ll help me operate a small network of TikTok accounts by posting finished videos that I provide. Captions, content, instructions, and workflows will already be prepared for you.



Your main job at first is:



→ Execute consistently  

→ Follow instructions accurately  

→ Keep everything organized  

→ Communicate when something isn’t working  

→ Make sure the posting system runs without me having to worry about it



But I want to be very clear:



THIS IS NOT INTENDED TO STAY A SIMPLE TIKTOK POSTING JOB.



If you’re great at what you do and we work well together, I would love for your role to grow significantly over time.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHAT YOU’LL DO INITIALLY



• Manage approximately 5–10 TikTok accounts



• Upload finished videos according to an organized posting schedule



• Use the correct captions, sounds, and posting instructions



• Keep accounts organized and operating reliably



• Track what has been posted and when



• Monitor basic performance and analytics



• Flag videos that perform unusually well or poorly



• Communicate account, login, verification, or posting issues quickly



• Follow a simple daily workflow/checklist



• Help make sure the entire content distribution system runs smoothly



You will generally NOT be responsible for creating the videos themselves.



The content will be provided.



Your initial role is primarily execution, consistency, organization, and attention to detail.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



I CARE A LOT ABOUT MAKING YOUR JOB EASY



I hate unnecessary busywork.



If there is a repetitive, frustrating, confusing, or unnecessarily slow part of your job, I want you to tell me.



I’m very proficient with AI, automation, software, and finding creative solutions to problems.



For example, you will not need to constantly type or manually search for captions. I use a free app that allows captions and other frequently used text to be pasted almost instantly using custom shortcuts/macros, and I’ll show you exactly how to set it up.



That philosophy applies to the entire job.



If something is annoying:



→ We can automate it.  

→ We can simplify it.  

→ We can build a better system.  

→ We can use AI.  

→ We can find a tool that solves it.



I would rather spend an hour improving a workflow once than make you waste 15 minutes every day for the next year.



My goal is to make your work as convenient, organized, low-friction, and easy to stay consistent with as possible.



And if YOU discover a smarter way of doing something, I absolutely want to hear it.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHERE THIS POSITION CAN GROW



I’m looking for someone I can hopefully work with for years, not just someone to complete a temporary freelance task.



As my career grows, the operation around it will grow too.



Eventually, that may include:



• TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other social platforms



• Content distribution and organization



• Analytics and performance reporting



• Trend and opportunity research



• Community management



• Artist marketing



• Music release campaigns



• Merchandise



• E-commerce



• Physical products



• Product launches



• Fan experiences



• Live shows



• Touring



• Fulfillment and logistics



• Coordinating contractors or other assistants



• Helping build systems for the broader artist business



• Other projects we probably haven’t even thought of yet



I’m intentionally trying to find someone BEFORE I desperately need a larger team.



I would much rather find one great person early, teach them how I work, build trust together, and gradually give them more responsibility.



For someone interested in music, entertainment, creators, social media, entrepreneurship, or artist management, this could become a genuinely interesting way to get involved in the music industry from the ground floor.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You do NOT need an enormous résumé.



I care much more about who you are and how you work.



I’m looking for someone who is:



✓ Extremely reliable



✓ Organized



✓ Detail-oriented



✓ Comfortable with technology



✓ Good at learning new tools



✓ Resourceful



✓ A strong communicator in English



✓ Comfortable working independently



✓ Curious



✓ Proactive



✓ Honest when something goes wrong



✓ Comfortable asking questions



✓ Interested in improving systems instead of blindly following inefficient ones



✓ Interested in staying long-term if the relationship works well



Previous experience managing several TikTok or social media accounts is highly preferred.



Experience in music, entertainment, creator businesses, e-commerce, short-form content, operations, AI, automation, or digital marketing is a major plus.



And if you already spend way too much time understanding TikTok, congratulations — that may finally be professionally useful.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHAT WORKING WITH ME IS LIKE



I’m ambitious and I care a lot about doing things well.



If something matters, I want it done correctly.



But I’m also a very relaxed person to work with.



I do not care about pretending to look busy.



I care about:



→ Is the work getting done?  

→ Is it being done correctly?  

→ Are we communicating?  

→ Are we improving over time?



If you can complete something efficiently, I’m not going to punish you for being efficient by inventing meaningless work.



I also care about the people who work with me.



I want the people on my team to feel respected, supported, fairly treated, and excited about what we’re building.



If something about the job sucks, please tell me.



If you’re overwhelmed, tell me.



If a process is stupid, tell me.



If you have a better idea, tell me.



I’d rather fix the problem than silently have you hate doing it for six months.



I take the work seriously without wanting the environment around it to feel corporate or miserable.



There will probably be weird projects.



There will constantly be new things to learn.



The operation will change as the career grows.



You should not be bored.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



SCHEDULE



The position will initially require approximately:



5–10 HOURS PER WEEK



For the right person, I expect this to gradually grow toward:



10–20+ HOURS PER WEEK



The schedule can be relatively flexible as long as required tasks and posts happen when they’re supposed to.



We will also have a short ONE-ON-ONE MEETING APPROXIMATELY EVERY TWO WEEKS.



Those meetings will be used to:



• Review what’s working



• Look at performance



• Solve problems



• Discuss new ideas



• Give each other feedback



• Identify inefficient parts of the workflow



• Improve systems



• Talk about what you’d like to learn



• D
 what additional responsibilities you’re ready to take on



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



COMPENSATION



STARTING PAY: $8 USD / HOUR



The position will start relatively small.



However, I want responsibility and compensation to grow as your value to the operation grows.



If you eventually become someone I can trust to independently manage important parts of the business, I do NOT expect you to remain an $8/hour assistant forever.



The goal is for the opportunity to grow if you grow with it.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following:



1. Where are you located?



2. How many TikTok or social media accounts have you managed simultaneously?



3. Have you ever helped grow an account from scratch? What happened?



4. What is the most successful social media account you’ve worked on, and what specifically did YOU do?



5. Are you comfortable managing approximately 5–10 accounts consistently?



6. What phone and computer setup do you currently use?



7. What other skills do you have that could eventually be useful to an independent music artist or creative business?



8. What type of work would you personally like to grow into over the next few years?



9. Tell me about something repetitive or frustrating that you’ve automated, simplified, or found a smarter way to do.



10. Why does this particular opportunity interest you?



IMPORTANT:



Start your application with the word:



EDEN



That lets me know you actually read the entire posting.



You do not need to write me a corporate essay.



I would much rather receive honest, thoughtful, specific answers.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



I’m ultimately looking for someone capable, kind, curious, resourceful, and dependable who sees the potential in joining early and building something long-term.



If you’re looking for a repetitive VA job where every Tuesday looks exactly the same forever, this probably isn’t it.



If you want to become genuinely valuable to a growing artist and creative business, learn a lot of strange things, work on increasingly interesting projects, and potentially build yourself a real position in the music industry along the way, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Experimentation Analyst (Part-Time - Split Testing & Data Quality)
description:
Do you have experience running and analyzing A/B or multivariate tests?



Are you fluent in Google Sheets or Excel — pivot tables, cohort tables, charts?



Do you understand statistical significance, sample size, and how to tell when a test is actually finished?



Do you actively push work forward instead of waiting to be told what to do next?



If yes to all four, you might be a great fit for this role.



We run ongoing split tests across our marketing funnels — testing different videos, headlines, page designs, and subscription routes to see what sells best. We need one careful, proactive person to own the system that keeps every test honest, organized, and moving.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



- Own the system of record for split tests. We already have a foundation — you'll take it over, build on it, and keep it sharp: one clear place that shows every test across every brand and where each one stands.

- Protect the data integrity of every split test. Set tests up so errors can't creep in, and on the rare occasion something slips through — a mismatched time window, a cherry-picked group, a wrong denominator — catch it before it reaches a decision.

- Make results easy to act on. Present each test so the winner, the margin, and the takeaway are clear at a glance — and make sure what we learn is captured where the team will actually use it, so no lesson gets lost.

- Reconcile the numbers. When two reports disagree on the same figure, find out which one is right and why, and write it down clearly so no one has to work it out again.

- Keep every new test set up right before it goes live — variables clearly identified, the success metric agreed up front, and the sample size worked out in advance.

- Stay on top of every running test and surface when it has enough data to call, so a winner is never picked too early.

- Push the pipeline forward. Keep test slots full, rank the backlog by leverage, and look ahead at what upcoming tests will need (tech setup, design assets, copy) so nothing stalls waiting on a dependency.



THE TOOLS



Day to day you'll work in spreadsheets and a handful of analytics and database tools — including Google Analytics (GA4), 
, HasOffers/TUNE, BigQuery, and a custom dashboard of our own. We'll get you up to speed on our specific setup; you bring the fundamentals.



We use AI tools in our own work, and you're welcome to use them here. What we care about is the judgment you bring on top of them. If you reach the paid test project, we'll ask which tools you used, AI included, and for the conversation logs.



YOU'RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU ARE



- Fluent in Google Sheets or Excel (pivot tables, cohort tables, charts).

- Comfortable with statistical hypothesis testing, significance, and sample-size estimation.

- Able to explain "why this test isn't done yet" to someone who isn't a statistician.

- Detail-oriented and organized — you don't let numbers slip through.

- Comfortable learning SQL, BI tools, or experimentation platforms.

- Someone who actively manages and pushes the work forward — keeps tests moving and flags what's next without waiting to be told.



TO APPLY



If you've read this far and think you'd be a great fit, reply with:



1. Why you're a strong match for this role.

2. Your favorite movie (so I know you read all the way to the end).



Qualified applicants will receive a short screening question, then a paid test project, then interviews with the hiring manager. One person will be chosen for the ongoing role after the trial.



This is a part-time contract: 10–20 hours per week, ongoing. Pay is $10–$15/hour, up to $18/hour for the right person.



This role requires you to track your hours with Time Doctor, which takes periodic screenshots of your screen while you work. If that is not comfortable for you, this is not the right fit.

title: Marketing Associate
description:
ABOUT IDL

IDL is building the first global professional dance league. Our first season brings together six pro teams, live events, major content moments, ticket on-sales, team announcements, and ecommerce drops for fans who want to support the league and represent their teams.



We are looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to build and run the
 and SMS engine that connects all of those moments.



This role is for someone who is strong at lifecycle marketing execution: campaign calendars, segmentation,
/SMS builds, automated flows, QA, reporting, and weekly optimization. Ecommerce products are part of the business, so you will support merch and product campaigns through lifecycle marketing. You do not need to own Shopify store operations.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own IDL's lifecycle marketing program across the full fan journey.



That means planning and executing campaigns around content drops, roster and team announcements, ticket on-sales, event reminders, merch drops, post-event follow-up, and fan re-engagement. You will build the flows, segments, QA process, and reporting rhythm that make
 and SMS a reliable channel for fan engagement and revenue.



This is a build role, not a maintenance role. IDL has a full season calendar and a growing audience, but the lifecycle program is still early. The right person will turn a busy marketing calendar into clear, well-timed, well-targeted fan communication.



What you'll own:

*Lifecycle campaign calendar

- Build and maintain the
/SMS calendar across IDL's season.

- Translate marketing, content, ticketing, event, and ecommerce priorities into clear lifecycle campaigns.

- Plan send timing, audience segments, message sequence, and channel mix for each major moment.

- Coordinate with internal stakeholders so campaigns have the copy, creative, links, offers, and approvals they need before launch.

- Flag conflicts, gaps, and missing inputs early instead of waiting until the send date.


 and SMS campaign execution

- Build, schedule, QA, and launch
 campaigns.

- Build, schedule, QA, and launch SMS campaigns where appropriate.

- Write or adapt clear lifecycle copy from provided campaign direction.

- Personalize campaigns by fan behavior, city, ticketing status, team affinity, ecommerce behavior, and engagement level.

- QA every campaign before launch: links, tracking, discounts or offer logic, audience rules, send time, rendering, and mobile readability.

*Lifecycle flows and automations

- Build and improve the core lifecycle flows, including:

- Welcome and onboarding

- Event city interest

- Ticket interest and ticket purchase follow-up

- Event reminder sequence

- Post-event recap and re-engagement

- Merch drop awareness and post-purchase follow-up

- Browse abandon, cart abandon, back-in-stock, and win-back where supported by the tools

- Monitor flow health and recommend improvements based on performance.

- Keep flows current as IDL's season, teams, events, and product calendar evolve.

*Segmentation and list health

- Build and maintain useful audience segments across the fan base.

- Segment by ticket buyers, event attendees, city interest, team affinity, merch buyers, SMS subscribers, engaged non-purchasers, and lapsed fans.

- Improve list growth, opt-in capture, engagement, deliverability, and unsubscribe health.

- Make sure sends are targeted and useful, not generic blasts.

*Ecommerce lifecycle support

- Support lifecycle campaigns for IDL merch and product drops.

- Build
/SMS sequences for launches, back-in-stock moments, limited-time offers, team product pushes, and post-purchase engagement.

- Partner with the ecommerce or merch owner on campaign inputs such as product details, offer logic, inventory constraints, and launch timing.

- Report on lifecycle contribution to ecommerce revenue, conversion, repeat purchase, and sell-through where data is available.



This role does not need to own Shopify product setup, PDP maintenance, inventory updates, theme edits, checkout QA, or fulfillment operations.

Reporting and optimization

Deliver a weekly lifecycle report with the key numbers and the recommended next actions.

Track campaign performance, flow performance, list growth, SMS opt-ins, deliverability, unsubscribe rates, revenue contribution, ticketing contribution, and ecommerce contribution.

Identify what worked, what did not, and what should change next.

Run practical tests around subject lines, send timing, segmentation, offers, and lifecycle sequencing.



WHAT YOU BRING:

*Must have

- 3+ years of hands-on lifecycle, CRM,
, SMS, or retention marketing experience.

- Direct experience building campaigns and flows in Klaviyo or a comparable ESP/SMS platform.

- Strong campaign calendar discipline across multiple launches, events, or business priorities.

- Experience with segmentation, automation, QA, campaign reporting, and performance recommendations.

- Comfortable supporting ecommerce marketing campaigns, especially product drops, limited-time offers, post-purchase flows, or abandoned-cart flows.

- Strong written English and clean async communication.

- Detail-oriented QA mindset. You catch broken links, wrong segments, missing tracking, bad timing, and unclear copy before customers do.

- Able to work US hours from the Philippines, with meaningful overlap with US Pacific Time.

*Nice to have

- Experience with sports, entertainment, live events, creators, communities, apparel, merch, or fan-driven brands.

- Experience with ticketing, event reminders, attendance-driving campaigns, or post-event re-engagement.

- SMS compliance familiarity, including consent, STOP/HELP language, quiet hours, and double opt-in where needed.

- Basic ecommerce analytics experience across revenue, conversion, AOV, repeat purchase, and sell-through.

- Basic HTML/CSS for
 cleanup.

- Working style



You are a strong fit if you:

- Like turning messy calendars into clear campaign plans.

- Are comfortable asking for missing inputs early.

- Can operate with direction but do not need daily hand-holding.

- Think in segments, timing, journeys, and QA checklists.

- Care about whether fans receive the right message at the right time.

- Can move fast without being sloppy.

- Know when to make a recommendation instead of only reporting numbers.



You are probably not a fit if you:



Only want strategy and do not want to build campaigns yourself.

Need someone else to define every step before you can act.

Think lifecycle marketing means sending the same newsletter to everyone.

Are looking for a pure ecommerce operations role.

Are not available for US-hour overlap.



FIRST 90 DAYS:

By the end of the first 90 days, you will have:

- Mapped IDL's season calendar into a lifecycle campaign calendar.

- Audited current
/SMS lists, segments, flows, forms, and reporting.

- Launched or improved the core flows: welcome, event interest, ticket purchase follow-up, event reminder, post-event re-engagement, merch drop support, abandoned cart, and post-purchase.

- Created a repeatable campaign QA process.

- Built a weekly lifecycle reporting format.

- Launched lifecycle campaigns for at least one major content moment, ticketing moment, event moment, and ecommerce product moment.

- Recommended the next highest-impact lifecycle improvements based on performance data.



LOGISTICS

Location: Philippines-based remote contractor

Schedule: US hours required, with core overlap during US Pacific business hours

Engagement: Full-time contractor

Compensation: [Insert monthly range]

Start date: [Insert target start date]

Tools: Klaviyo or comparable ESP/SMS platform, Shopify data as needed, Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, analytics/reporting tools as available



HOW TO APPLY:

Please send:

Your resume or LinkedIn profile.

A 1 minute intro loom video

A short note on the most relevant lifecycle program you have run.

The ESP/SMS tools you have used hands-on.

Examples of flows or campaigns you have built, with sensitive information removed.

One example of a lifecycle metric you improved and what you changed to improve it.

Your availability for US Pacific Time overlap.

title: Claude Vibe Coding · Workflow Automation Specialist
description:
Claude Implementation · Vibe Coding · Workflow Automation



Company: AI L3 Tech Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent Contractor 

Compensation: Depending on experience



About AI L3 Tech

AI L3 Tech delivers senior-level (Level 3) engineering and escalation support to Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and their clients. Our engineers bring deep, hands-on expertise — they know their stuff — and use AI as a force multiplier to work smarter and resolve complex problems faster. We're trusted to operate independently, step into unfamiliar environments with confidence, and represent AI L3 Tech directly with partners and their end customers.



Role Summary

We're hiring a senior AI & Automation Specialist (Level 3) to lead Claude adoption across multiple MSP environments. You'll own Claude implementations as a productized service — for our MSP partners and for their end customers — you'll vibe code the web applications, mobile apps, and automations those businesses actually need, and you'll be the top-tier escalation point when AI and automation work gets hard.

This is a deeply technical, customer-facing role — not a sales role and not a junior role. We're HIGH-LEVEL specialists, and we expect you to do amazing things. If it can be built or automated with Claude, you'll make it happen.

We're looking for an agile vibe coder. Someone who can sit in a discovery call in the morning, put a working prototype in front of the customer that afternoon, and have a deployed, documented solution by the end of the week. Speed matters here — but so does finishing. We ship real things people use, not demos that die in a sandbox.



What You'll Do

Vibe Code Real Solutions (this is the job)

Vibe code working software fast — web applications, mobile apps, internal tools, and customer-facing micro-SaaS — with Claude Code as your primary development environment.

Turn a whiteboard idea into a functioning tool in days, not months — then iterate with the customer in the loop until it actually fits how their business runs.

Finish what you start. Deployed, documented, supportable: auth, data, hosting, error handling, handoff. A prototype that never leaves your laptop doesn't count.

Build with the Claude API: agents, tool use, integrations, MCP servers, and prompts treated as engineering artifacts, not chat-window experiments.

Build for mobile when the business problem calls for a phone instead of a browser.

Ship micro-SaaS solutions for MSPs and their customers — small, focused applications that solve one business problem well.

Set AI L3 Tech's application development standards — stacks, repos, deployment, security, documentation — so what you build can be supported by someone who isn't you.

Automate Everything Worth Automating

Design, build, and maintain automations across n8n, Zapier, Make, Rewst, and Microsoft Power Automate — and know which one is right for the job, and when to skip all of them and just write the code.

Wire Claude into those workflows: AI-driven steps inside real production automations — document processing, ticket triage, data extraction, classification, drafting, approvals.

Serve as the senior escalation point for complex, broken, or fragile automations across multiple MSP environments — including automations you didn't build.

Drive root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes — not band-aids.

Identify automation opportunities others miss: if a process is manual, repetitive, or error-prone, you see it and you fix it.

Build on the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI) when that's where the customer already lives.

Deploy & Support Claude for End Users

Run Claude rollouts as a standard, repeatable project for MSP partners — then run the same playbook for their end customers.

Set up and support Claude Cowork for real end users: connected folders, connectors and MCP servers, Projects, and scheduled tasks — configured around their actual work, not a generic demo.

Build Claude Projects, Skills, and custom connectors that encode a customer's own processes, documents, and standards.

Provide hands-on end-user support: onboarding sessions, office hours, troubleshooting when "Claude did something weird," and prompt and workflow coaching that turns skeptics into daily users.

Drive adoption that sticks — train teams, build internal champions, and measure outcomes.

Set the standards for Claude governance, security, and supportability — data boundaries, admin settings, licensing — and keep integrations correctly configured with vendors.

Consult, Scope & Advise

Meet directly with stakeholders, run SWOT and discovery sessions, and understand the real business problem before recommending a solution.

Lead projects end to end — scoping, design, build, deployment, documentation, and handoff.

Advise MSP partners on AI strategy, tool selection, licensing, and long-term roadmaps.

Help build out our SOPs, development standards, and productized service offerings. AI L3 Tech is early — you'll shape how we deliver, not inherit a manual.

Stay current on Claude's capabilities as they ship, and share what you learn internally and with partners.



What We're Looking For



Required

Demonstrable Claude work. Something we can look at: a repo, a shipped tool, a live agent, a working micro-SaaS. We will open the link. Enthusiasm for AI in prose is not a substitute.

Proven vibe coding with Claude Code — finished, deployed solutions, not prototypes. Be ready to walk us through something you shipped: how fast, what broke, and what you'd do differently.

Enough full-stack range to finish the job: front end, back end, a database, auth, and deployment. You don't have to be a specialist in any of them — you do have to get an application safely into production and keep it running.

Proven, hands-on experience building and supporting automations in production at a senior level, including automations you didn't build. This is not a role for someone new to AI or automation.

Hands-on experience with at least two of n8n, Zapier, Make, Rewst, or Power Automate.

Comfort in front of non-technical end users — training, enabling, and supporting people who are new to AI and not always thrilled about it.

Consultative skills: you can sit with a business owner, run a SWOT, ask the right questions, and translate their problem into a working solution.

Strong written and spoken English — with engineers, business stakeholders, and end customers alike.

Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and own problems through to resolution.

Preferred

Experience working in or with MSPs — comfort operating across many client environments with varying standards and documentation quality.

Mobile app development (React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin).

Hands-on with Claude Cowork, Claude Projects, Claude Skills, or MCP server development.

Microsoft 365 administration and the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI).

Other AI tooling (ChatGPT, Codex, OpenAI APIs) and a working opinion about where each one fits.

Experience turning a technical service into a repeatable, productized offering.



Why AI L3 Tech?

We're passionate about efficiency and innovation through AI and automation.

Work remotely on cutting-edge AI, application, and workflow projects.

Trusted by MSPs to deliver smarter, faster, and scalable solutions.

You're early enough to set the standards rather than follow them.



To Apply Please submit:

1) Your resume.

2) A short audio sample — 1–2 minutes introducing yourself and your experience, so we can hear your spoken communication style.

Build organized proposed purchase orders for assigned supplier accounts

Maintain accurate spreadsheets and records of your work



Thoroughness is extremely important. We do not want someone who looks at the first 50 products in a catalog, finds three winners, and stops. We want someone who will systematically work through an account and make sure profitable opportunities aren't being missed.



Accuracy is equally important. Every product recommended for purchase must meet our profitability criteria after product cost, Amazon fees, and other applicable costs are considered.

Experience using Keepa

Strong understanding of profit, ROI, Amazon fees, pricing, sales history, and competition

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills

Excellent attention to detail

Preferred Experience

Amazon wholesale

Amazon Seller Central

SmartScout

SoStocked or similar inventory/restocking software

InventoryLab

Building wholesale purchase or restock orders



This is a long-term, full-time position. We offer a flexible work schedule and flexible time off with advance notice.



Our goal is to find someone who can eventually take ownership of this process. We want to assign you a supplier account and be confident that its catalog, existing products, restocks, and purchasing opportunities have been thoroughly and accurately reviewed.

title: YouTube Analytics &  Optimization VA
description:
Company Overview

A growing luxury lifestyle YouTube channel focused on high quality watch reviews, strap showcases,

buying guides, and product breakdowns for watch enthusiasts. The channel emphasizes clean visuals,

polished editing, and a refined tone suitable for viewers interested in high end or unique timepieces.

Role Overview

This role supports the Watch Piece Unique channel by owning analytics review, title and thumbnail

optimization, and performance testing. Working alongside the channel's video editor, this person

ensures every upload is set up to perform, using data to guide decisions on titles, thumbnails, and

content strategy. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail oriented, and comfortable translating numbers

into clear, actionable recommendations.

This is a remote, part time role with room to expand as the channel grows.

Key Responsibilities

1. Analytics Monitoring and Reporting

• Review YouTube Studio analytics regularly, including CTR, average view duration, retention

curves, impressions, and traffic sources.

•

Identify trends, drop-off points, and outlier performance across uploads.

• Provide simple, digestible performance summaries and flag videos that need attention.

2. Title and Thumbnail Optimization

• Audit existing video titles and thumbnails against performance data.

• A/B test title and thumbnail variations to improve CTR without sacrificing the channel's premium

tone.

• Research competitor channels and category benchmarks for what's working in the watch/luxury

lifestyle space.

• Collaborate with the editor on thumbnail concepts, text placement, and visual hierarchy grounded in

what the data shows.

3. Metadata and Discoverability

• Recommend tags, descriptions, and keyword strategy to support search and suggested traffic.

• Support chapter, playlist, and end screen structuring to improve session watch time.

4. Strategy Support



• Suggest content or series ideas backed by what audience data shows resonates.

• Track goals and deliverables tied to channel growth (subscribers, watch time, CTR benchmarks).

• Communicate findings clearly to guide upload decisions before publishing.

Qualifications and Skills

• Proven experience with YouTube Studio analytics and channel growth strategy.

• Strong understanding of thumbnail and title testing best practices, including A/B testing tools and

CTR benchmarks.

• Comfortable working independently and communicating findings clearly and concisely.

• Detail oriented, organized, and proactive about flagging issues or opportunities.

• Reliable availability during CST business hours for light collaboration with the editor.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with luxury watches, collecting, or lifestyle/product content.

• Experience with tools like TubeBuddy, VidIQ, or similar.

• Basic understanding of short form platform algorithms (Shorts, TikTok, Reels).

title: Follow Up & Operations Coordinator
description:
Purpose of the Role



The primary purpose of this role is to make sure agreed actions get completed.



The role will support our Sales & Marketing, Operations, Finance and R&D teams by managing weekly meeting agendas and action trackers, and following up with the people responsible for completing agreed tasks.



The role does not require attendance at the meetings.



Key Responsibilities



Follow-Up & Accountability – Main Priority

• Prepare and circulate meeting agendas.

• Update action trackers following meetings.

• Ensure every action has a clear owner and deadline.

• Follow up with team members to ensure actions are completed on time, chase where necessary.

• Chase overdue actions and escalate where necessary.

• Prepare outstanding-action updates ahead of the next meeting.

• Maintain clear action trackers across all departments.



The role is not to complete other people's actions, but to make sure the responsible person completes them.



Operations & Project Support

Once follow-up responsibilities are up to date, remaining time will primarily support Operations, including:

• Assisting with project coordination and administration.

• Maintaining project trackers, deadlines and milestones.

• Following up with suppliers, subcontractors and internal team members.

• Assisting with operational processes and ensuring they are followed.

• Identifying delays, missing information and bottlenecks.

• Helping improve and document processes.



The Person

We are looking for someone who is:

• Highly organised, proactive and persistent.

• Comfortable chasing people and holding them accountable.

• Polite but firm when following up.

• Excellent in written and spoken English.

• Able to work independently.

• Confident using Microsoft 365.

• Ideally experienced in project coordination, operations or administration.



In simple terms: know what was agreed, who owns it, when it is due, and make sure it gets done.



If you are interested in this role, please put the phrase “We Keep Water Flowing” at the top of your response.

title: Technical Support Specialist - Security Systems
description:
This is remote technical support for a company that installs and maintains security systems - alarm panels, cameras, DVR and NVR recorders, and access control. Customers call when something has stopped working, and your job is to work out why without being able to touch anything yourself. That is the whole shape of the role: you ask the right questions, you listen to what the person on the other end reports back, and you narrow it down from there. Sometimes it is a network or connectivity problem affecting an IP camera. Sometimes it is a panel that needs reprogramming. Sometimes it is a genuinely faulty device and the right answer is to stop and send a technician. You will guide customers through resolution steps by phone,
 and remote access, document every issue and fix in the ticketing system, help with system configuration and programming, and coordinate with field technicians when a site visit is needed. The customers are mostly not technical, so the ability to explain what is happening in plain language matters as much as the diagnosis itself. 



What you’ll do

Provide remote technical support to customers with alarm systems, cameras and access control

Troubleshoot system faults by phone,
 and remote access

Technical support experience with security systems, alarms or low-voltage systems

Remote troubleshooting and diagnostics

Ability to guide customers through technical steps by phone

Ticketing system experience

Excellent verbal and written English communication

Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers

Strong problem-solving skills

Comfortable working alongside field technicians

Able to work independently



Nice to have

Experience with Honeywell, Bosch, Hikvision, Dahua or similar systems

Knowledge of access control systems

Experience with alarm monitoring platforms

title: Xactimate Estimator- Fire & Water Damage Restoration
description:
Xactimate Estimator- Fire & Water Damage Restoration



About Us

We are a growing fire and water damage restoration company DBA Servpro Team Clemente based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA. We handle residential and commercial mitigation and restoration projects and work with all major insurance carriers. We're looking for an experienced Xactimate estimator to join our remote team long-term.



The Role

You will write mitigation estimates in Xactimate based on job files we send you. Each job file includes:

Photos of the loss

Documentation (moisture readings, drying logs, equipment logs, sketches/measurements)

A written scope of work from our field team

Your job is to turn that file into a complete, accurate, carrier-ready Xactimate estimate.

Responsibilities

Write water and fire mitigation estimates in Xactimate (X1/XactRemodel/online)

Create or verify sketches from provided measurements

Apply correct line items for water extraction, demolition, drying equipment, cleaning, and content manipulation

Follow IICRC S500/S520 standards and carrier guidelines

Ensure estimates are complete — no missed line items — and defensible to adjusters

Make revisions based on adjuster feedback or reviewer notes

Meet turnaround deadlines (typically 24 hours from receiving a complete job file)

Communicate clearly with our team about missing documentation or scope questions

Requirements

2+ years of hands-on Xactimate estimating experience, specifically in water and/or fire mitigation & Reconstruction

Strong understanding of the mitigation process: extraction, demo, drying, equipment placement and duration

Familiarity with insurance carrier requirements and common pushback (e.g., equipment justification, per-day charges)

Excellent written English

Reliable internet and computer capable of running Xactimate

Able to overlap with US Central Time for at least 2–3 hours daily

Detail-oriented — you catch what others miss

Nice to Have

IICRC WRT/ASD certification or equivalent knowledge

Experience with Dash, Encircle, Docusketch, or similar documentation platforms

Experience with Xactimate sketch from Matterport or field measurements

Experience writing fire/smoke estimates (cleaning, sealing, pack-out)



How to Apply

To show you read this posting carefully, please start your application with the word "DRYWALL" and include:

Years of Xactimate experience and which version(s) you use

Whether your experience is mitigation, reconstruction, or both

1–2 sample estimates you've written (redact any personal/client info)

Your available hours in US Central Time

Availability for a Virtual Interview

Applications that don't follow these instructions will not be considered.

We're looking for someone who wants a long-term role with a stable, growing company — not a one-off project. If you're accurate, reliable, and know mitigation estimating, we want to hear from you.

title: Experienced Executive / Personal Assistant
description:
I’m looking for an experienced Executive/Personal Assistant to work directly with me as a business owner. This is not a general VA or data-entry role. Your purpose is to buy back my time by managing day-to-day communication, organization, and follow-ups—and involving me only when necessary.



### Responsibilities



* Manage my inbox so I spend no more than 30 minutes daily on

* Handle routine
s, draft replies, and flag only what needs my response

* Manage my calendar, meetings, appointments, and reminders

* Monitor important WhatsApp groups and conversations

* Clearly escalate issues that require my attention, with the necessary context

* Follow up with team members and track outstanding tasks

* Communicate with me throughout the day

* Learn how I make decisions and gradually handle more independently

* Improve systems and workflows that save me time



The role may eventually include travel planning, reservations, appointments, research, purchases, and other personal-assistant tasks.



### Requirements



You must have previous experience working directly with a business owner, CEO, entrepreneur, or executive. I want someone proactive who can recommend better systems—not someone who waits for every instruction.



Relevant experience should include:



* Inbox and calendar management

* Scheduling, follow-ups, and escalations

* Task or project management

* Handling confidential information

* Google Workspace, CRMs, WhatsApp, Slack, Loom, AI tools, or similar platforms



You don’t need experience with every platform, but you must learn software quickly and be comfortable using multiple business systems.



### Most Important Principle



Your job is not to bring me more things to manage—it is to remove things from my plate.



Handle what you can independently. If I need to make a decision, present it clearly and efficiently. Ask questions at first, then learn my preferences and become increasingly independent.



### Required Loom Video



I will only review applications that include a Loom video of no more than five minutes. Applications containing only a résumé or generic response will not be considered.



In your video:



1. Briefly introduce yourself.

2. Describe a role where you worked directly with an owner or executive.

3. Show and explain your actual workflow, including:



* How you managed their inbox and calendar

* What you handled yourself versus escalated

* How tasks and urgent issues were communicated and tracked

* How you kept the executive from checking every message or group

* What your normal workday looked like

* Which software, CRMs, communication, project-management, and AI tools you used



If possible, share your screen and show real workflow examples while protecting confidential information. I care more about how you actually worked than a generic list of skills.



### Include With Your Application



* Résumé

* Loom video link

* Expected weekly or monthly compensation

* Availability and working hours/time zone

* Earliest possible start date



Again, applications without a Loom video will not be reviewed.



I’m looking for someone who can become a highly trusted partner and dramatically reduce the time I spend on administrative and operational details.

title: ON-SITE, EVERY WORKING DAY — Operations / Production Manager, Small Video Editing Team (City Open — Philippines)
description:
ON-SITE, EVERY WORKING DAY — Operations / Production Manager, Small Video Editing Team (City Open — Philippines)



We are a US-based media company that produces long-form YouTube content at scale. We are opening a small, dedicated editing office in the Philippines and looking for ONE strong manager to run it.



City is open. We'll base the office wherever the person we hire already has a team they can pull from and a building that meets our standard. This is primarily a people-and-operations role, with hands-on editing as a backup skill — not a full-time editing job.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Recruit and build a team of 3-5 video editors in your city

- Help choose and set up the office — evaluating buildings against our spec, coordinating move-in, and getting the workspace ready

- Manage the daily workflow: assign work, hold deadlines, keep quality consistent

- Train the team to our style and standards (we provide the system and the scripts)

- Judge editing quality and catch issues before they ship

- Step in and edit yourself when someone is out sick, or when something urgent needs to get done — not a daily requirement

- Manage the workspace, the equipment and attendance

- Report once a day to our team abroad — you are our person on the ground



THE 3-WEEK TARGET

What we mean by this: 3 weeks from your start date to having the office running with 3 editors actively working in it. That covers choosing the building, getting equipment set up, recruiting editors, and onboarding them — not 3 weeks until you personally walk through the door.



That said, quality matters more than hitting the number exactly. We would rather have week 4 with three good editors than week 3 with two good ones and one warm body rushed in to hit a deadline. The last two hires especially are judged on fit and quality, not just speed.



This is exactly why an existing network of editors in your city is a real advantage — recruiting from a cold start while also setting up an office in 3 weeks is genuinely difficult.



WHAT WE NEED

- ON-SITE, EVERY WORKING DAY. This is not remote and not hybrid — if you cannot commit to being physically present every working day, please do not apply

- An existing network of video editors in your city you can bring in quickly — tell us who, how many, and where

- A building in your city that can meet our office spec (see below) — tell us if you already have somewhere in mind

- Experience as a team lead, lead editor, or someone who has supervised editors, managed workflow, or done QA/review on a team's output — tell us what that looked like

- Basic-to-solid hands-on video editing ability — enough to judge quality and step in when needed. You do NOT need to be a world-class editor or edit every day. Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects preferred. Tell us what software you use and share a portfolio/reel

- Excellent English, written and spoken

- Comfortable with project management tools (ClickUp, Trello, Asana or similar)

- NBI clearance and at least 2 references we can actually call



THE OFFICE SPEC

Wherever the office ends up, the building must have:

- Security with controlled access

Job Title: Automation Product Builder



About the Role



We're Network Brainiacs — a team that lives for spotting broken workflows and rebuilding them smarter. We're looking for a full-time builder who sees a messy business process and can't help fixing it. You'll spend your days turning manual chaos into working software: automations, dashboards, agents, and internal tools that make real operations run smoother. You're not waiting for specs. You're hearing "our invoicing process is a mess" and coming back with a working prototype that proves a better way.



Coding is no longer the bottleneck — judgment is. The leverage in this role isn't writing code faster; it's being right about what to build. You'll own problems end-to-end: understand the workflow, d
 what should exist, build it, test it, and tell us whether it's worth keeping.



A quick note on how we work: you'll RDP into a dedicated Windows dev environment we provide, accessed through your assigned Azure credentials. It comes fully loaded with our toolchain — Claude Code, Cursor, our test data, the works. No setup headaches, no "works on my machine," no AI subscriptions on your dime. You log in and build. Our internal team handles the production codebase merge on our side, so you stay focused on what you do best.



What You'll Own



Designing and shipping automations that replace manual work — invoice flows, estimate pipelines, client onboarding, ticket routing, reporting, anything currently done by hand. Building dashboards that surface what matters instead of dumping data. Prototyping AI agents that handle real tasks: drafting follow-ups, flagging anomalies, summarizing activity, triaging requests. Spotting workflows that scream "automate me" and pitching them before we ask.



Who You Are



You think in systems. When you see a process, you can't help mapping it — what's the input, where are the failure points, what should the agent d
 versus what stays human? You've built things people actually use, not just toy projects.



You're fluent with AI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, n8n, Make, Zapier, whatever fits the job — and you have strong opinions about which one to reach for and when. You can build a React dashboard, wire up an API, prompt an LLM into doing real work, and stitch it all together into something that runs.



You have product instincts. You'll push back when an idea is wrong and pitch better ones. You know when something is "done enough" versus when it needs another pass. You're comfortable hearing "this isn't quite right, try again" without ego.



You're self-directed. We're not going to hand you tickets. We'll describe a problem and expect you to come back with options.



Nice to Have



Experience with PSA tools, Autotask, ConnectWise, or other MSP platforms. Background in invoicing, billing, or accounting workflows. Familiarity with workflow automation platforms (n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate). A portfolio of side projects or shipped tools that didn't need a manager to exist.



Logistics



Full-time, fully remote. You'll need a reliable internet connection and a computer capable of running a stable Windows RDP session — we'll provision your dev environment, Azure credentials, and AI tooling. We collaborate through specs, demos, and conversation — not tickets.

title: B2B Cold Caller / Freight Sales
description:
Company Overview: A premier US-based freight brokerage and cold chain specialist. We pride ourselves on precision, operational excellence, and power in our partnerships. As we aggressively expand our domestic lane capacity, we are looking for a relentless, hungry, and highly organized B2B Outbound Appointment Setter to join our team. Your mission is simple: break through gatekeepers, connect with Logistics Managers, and put qualified shippers on our calendar.



What You'll Be Doing (Key Responsibilities)

► High-Volume Outbound Dialing: Execute 150+ cold calls per day using our cloud-based auto-dialer to target US-based manufacturers, distributors, and shippers.

► Bypass Gatekeepers: Use confident, authoritative, and strategic conversation styles to get transferred directly to decision-makers (Traffic Managers, Logistics Directors, VPs of Supply Chain).

► Qualify & Pitch: Introduce Stag Logistics concisely. Ask sharp qualifying questions to identify the shipper’s current pain points (lane failures, capacity issues, spot market stress).

► Book Appointments: Secure qualified phone meetings or live "warm transfers" for our US-based closing team.

► Maintain CRM Hygiene: Record clean call notes, track lead statuses accurately, and log calendar invitations seamlessly with zero data chaos.



Who You Are (Required Qualifications):

► The "Hunter" Personality: You have high personal drive, an unphased attitude toward rejection, and thick skin. An angry hang-up doesn’t ruin your day; it fuels your next dial.

► Flawless Communication: An exceptionally clear, natural English accent with strong conversational flow and peer-to-peer business authority. (We do not want robotic or passive telemarketers).

► Industry Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of experience in B2B cold calling. Prior experience in US Freight Brokerage/Logistics sales is a massive advantage.

► Tech-Savvy: Comfortable operating cloud dialers, CRM pipelines, and calendar scheduling software (e.g., Hubspot, Salesforce, Calendly).

► Rock-Solid Setup: A dedicated home office space, a noise-canceling headset, high-speed fiber internet with backup, and a reliable power source.What’s In It For You (Compensation & Perks)

► Competitive Base Salary (Paid reliably on time).

► Aggressive Performance Bonuses / Commissions for every qualified appointment set that turns into an active shipping trial.

► 100% Remote, work-from-home freedom.

► Comprehensive training on our specific lane capacity and logistics strategy.

► Fixed Shift: Monday to Friday (US Business Hours).

==================================================

How to Apply (Do Not Skip): To ensure you can follow strict operational instructions, your application will not be considered if you skip these steps:

[1] Send a direct message with a link to your resume/CV.

[2] Include a 1-minute voice recording (using Vocaroo or Loom) introducing yourself and explaining your biggest win in B2B cold calling.

[3] Change the subject line of your application to exactly: "I am the next Hunter for Stag Logistics"
