description:
E-Commerce Store Manager – Shopify & AI Specialist



Remote Position | Long-Term Opportunity | Part-Time to Start, With Growth Potential



About the Business



We are a growing U.S.-based e-commerce business specializing in outdoor living products, including patio furniture, outdoor kitchens, grills, gazebos, fire pits, and related products.



Our Shopify store is relatively new, and we are looking for an intelligent, dependable and highly resourceful person who can help manage and grow the business.



This is not simply a data-entry or virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the business and who is capable of taking increasing responsibility for the day-to-day management of the store.



A major priority is finding someone who is highly comfortable using artificial intelligence tools such as ChatGPT and other AI platforms to work faster, solve problems, create content and improve business operations.



Responsibilities



The person selected will gradually assume responsibility for many of the store's daily operations, including:



Managing and updating our Shopify store

Adding and optimizing products

Writing and improving product titles and descriptions

Organizing product images, collections, tags and specifications

Monitoring orders and coordinating order fulfillment

Communicating with suppliers regarding orders, inventory and shipping

Responding professionally to customer questions and
s

Tracking shipments and proactively handling delivery issues

Handling returns, cancellations and customer-service problems according to company policies

Researching products, competitors and pricing

Improving product pages for SEO and conversions

Assisting with
 marketing and promotions

Helping create social media and marketing content

Maintaining spreadsheets, reports and operational records

Identifying problems before they become customer problems

Suggesting improvements to the store and our operating procedures

AI Skills Are Important



We are specifically interested in candidates who already use AI as part of their work.



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar AI systems for tasks including:



Product research

Product descriptions

SEO

Customer-service responses

Supplier communications

Marketing copy

 campaigns

Social media content

Competitive research

Data analysis

Creating procedures and SOPs

Brainstorming and problem-solving

Automating repetitive business tasks



We are not looking for someone who simply copies and pastes AI-generated material.



We want someone who understands how to prompt AI effectively, verify its work, edit the results and use AI to become a better e-commerce manager.



Experience with AI automation tools or Shopify AI applications is a major plus.



Qualifications



The ideal candidate will have:



Previous Shopify experience

E-commerce store management experience

Excellent written English

Strong customer-service skills

Experience communicating with U.S. customers

Strong attention to detail

Good organizational skills

Ability to work independently

Excellent internet research skills

Experience with Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel

Experience using AI tools professionally

Ability to learn new software quickly

Reliable computer and internet connection

A proactive attitude toward solving problems



Experience with SEO, Canva,
 marketing, Google Merchant Center, Meta/Facebook, Google Ads, social media, Shopify apps or e-commerce automation is highly desirable.



The Person We Are Looking For



Technical skills are important, but character is equally important.



We want someone who is:



Honest and trustworthy

Dependable

Intelligent and resourceful

Detail-oriented

Comfortable asking questions

Willing to admit when they don't know something

Able to research a problem and propose a solution

Interested in learning

Interested in AI and new technology

Looking for a long-term position rather than a temporary project



The right person should eventually be able to look at the store and ask:



“What needs to be done today?”



rather than waiting for the owner to provide instructions for every task.



Growth Opportunity



Initially, you will work closely with the owner while learning the business, suppliers, products and operating procedures.



As trust and experience develop, we would like the successful candidate to assume increasing responsibility for the daily operation of the store.



For an exceptional candidate, this could eventually develop into a Store Manager / E-Commerce Operations Manager position with substantial responsibility.



How to Apply



Please send us the following:

title: Deal Manager - US Real Estate Dispositions & Closings (Remote, US Eastern hours)
description:
We are a Norfolk, Virginia (USA) real estate investment company operating across five LLCs - flipping houses, wholesaling deals, and managing a rental portfolio in Virginia and North Carolina. 200+ transactions since 2015. We are a HomeVestors franchise.



We already have lead generation handled. We already have someone who signs contracts. What we do not have is anyone who owns what happens AFTER the contract is signed - moving the deal to a buyer, to the closing table, and to money in the bank. That is this seat, and dispositions is the heart of it.



Here is the honest picture of what you would be walking into, measured in our CRM this month:



- 87 leads. ZERO are assigned to one single owner - every one is assigned to two or three people, so each assumes someone else has it.

- Under-contract date, under-contract price, scheduled closing date: 0 of 87 filled in. The fields exist. They are all empty.

- 31 leads are parked waiting on an offer or an appointment, 26 of them 18+ days old, because nothing flags a deal that stops moving.

- A deal closed on the 14th of this month. We found out on the 18th, and only because a settlement statement happened to land in an inbox. Nothing in the pipeline showed it existed. That same statement had a commission computed on one sales price while the contract price on the same page was materially lower - and nobody caught it before signing.



If reading that made you want to open a spreadsheet, keep reading.



THE SEAT IN ONE LINE: you manage the work, not the people.



You are the third seat on a three-person acquisitions team, and you sit BESIDE the other two, not above them. One teammate owns raw lead to scored to hot handoff. One owns hot lead to appointment to signed contract. You own everything after the signature: the buyer, the paperwork, the deadlines, the closing table, and the money - plus you keep the whole pipeline honest by flagging anything that stops moving.



You will not set anyone's targets and you will not run anyone's review. You own the facts; the Operations Manager owns the enforcement. Your pressure comes from a visible, dated flag list read out at standup every morning, and anything that has not moved in 48 hours goes up to Operations with its history attached.



=====================================================

WHAT YOU WILL DO

=====================================================



1) DISPOSITIONS - the core of the seat



- Find and lock the end buyer on every wholesale and assignment deal we put under contract. Cash buyers, landlords, other investors, agents with investor clients.

- Build and maintain our buyers list. We do not have a real one yet. You will.

- Price the assignment to actually move, and negotiate the assignment fee.

- Get the deposit collected and the assignment paperwork out.

- When a deal is not selling, say so early and come with the reason - price, condition, area, or buyer pool - not five days before closing.



2) OWN - contract to cash



- Build and own the deal board. Every deal that goes under contract gets a row on day one and keeps it until funds are confirmed: address, deal type, contract date, contract price, deposit and whether it was actually received, inspection deadline, financing deadline, title company and file number, title ordered / commitment received, end buyer and their deposit, scheduled closing date, extensions used, expected proceeds or assignment fee, status, and next action + who + by when.

- Work the critical dates. Inspection, financing, title commitment, deposit, extensions - deadlines inside 5 days get handled first.

- Call the closing side live. Title companies, lenders, closing attorneys. An unanswered
 is not a follow-up.

- Hold the seller's hand. Sellers under contract go quiet and get cold feet. Weekly minimum, more as closing approaches.

- Read the settlement statement before it is signed and reconcile it against the contract. See the story above.



3) WATCH AND FLAG - the pipeline as a system



Every morning, sweep our CRM and the franchise system and build one list: every lead and every deal that needs an action today. The triggers are written down and not up to your mood: new lead with no contact attempt in 24 hrs, contacted but unscored in 48 hrs, scored hot but not handed off same day, parked at offer-needed 7 days, appointment run with no offer in 48 hrs, offer made with no seller response in 5 days, under contract with no board row same day, any critical date inside 5 days immediately.



Every flag carries three things: the lead, the NAME of the person who owns the next action, and the DATE it is due. A flag without an owner and a date is a complaint, not a flag.



End of every day: a short report - what moved, what did not, what is blocking.



=====================================================

WHAT THIS SEAT DOES NOT DO - read this twice

=====================================================



- Does not quote or negotiate the purchase price with sellers. Buy-side pricing sits with the acquisitions seat, and above a threshold, the owner. Your negotiating is on the SELL side - the assignment fee and the end buyer.

- Does not sign, send, or modify contracts.

- Does not d
 to kill a deal. You recommend; acquisitions or the owner d
.

- Does not move money or touch banking credentials. Ever.

- Does not set targets or run performance reviews for anyone.

- Is not a cold-calling or appointment-setting seat. We have that covered.



=====================================================

WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR - please self-select out

=====================================================



- Not an appointment setter or a lead-gen caller. That seat is filled. You will not be handed a dial list and a script.

- Not a general VA. This is not inbox management, calendar work, or data entry with a real-estate label on it.

- Not a manager-of-people role. No direct reports, now or later. If the appeal is the word "Manager" in the title, we are not a match.

- Not a seat for someone who needs a finished playbook. The deal board does not exist yet - building it is day two.



=====================================================

REQUIREMENTS

=====================================================



REQUIRED - this is what we are actually screening on:



- 2+ years in US real estate DISPOSITIONS. You have personally sold or assigned deals to end buyers. Wholesale assignments, novations, JV dispo, or flip dispo all count.

- You have built or worked a real cash-buyers list and can describe how you built it, how you kept it warm, and how big it got.

- You have carried deals from signed contract through closing - title company, lender, attorney, deadlines, settlement statement.

- You know what a settlement statement is and you have caught an error on one.

- Comfortable on the phone with US buyers, sellers, and closing professionals. Clear spoken English.

- Organized to the point of being slightly annoying about it. Deadlines are the entire job.

- Willing to tell a teammate, in front of the team and without apology, that something on their plate has been sitting for eleven days.

- Reliable computer, reliable internet, quiet space for calls.



A PLUS, BUT NOT REQUIRED:



- Lead management / ISA / acquisitions experience. Useful context, and it will help you read the front half of the pipeline - but it is not what this seat is measured on, and it will not make up for thin dispositions experience.

- Real estate CRM experience (REsimpli, Podio, Salesforce, or similar).

- Title-portal experience (Qualia, ResWare, SoftPro).

- HomeVestors or franchise-system familiarity.



=====================================================

WHAT WE WILL GIVE YOU

=====================================================



- A $250 bonus on every deal you close, uncapped, on top of the hourly rate.

- A written operating manual for this seat. The triggers, the escalation ladder, and the board fields are already documented, not improvised.

- A daily 15-minute standup where your flag list is the agenda.

- A working escalation path: what you flag and nobody moves on goes to the Operations Manager with your history attached, and he acts on it.

- Direct access to decision-makers. No committee.

- Existing systems you operate rather than build - CRM, automated lead-gen, automated valuation, and a real vendor stack of title companies, lenders, property managers, and a CPA.

- A pipeline with deals already in it and nobody working the back half. Your bonus is not theoretical.



=====================================================

HOURS AND TERMS

=====================================================



US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM ET (30 hours per week). The 8:00 AM start is fixed - team standup is 8:00 to 8:15 ET.

Independent contractor, 30-day mutual evaluation period. Time tracked in Hubstaff.



=====================================================

HOW TO APPLY - answer these in your application

=====================================================



Applications without answers to these will not be reviewed.



1. Can you work US Eastern hours Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM Eastern, starting at 8:00 AM every day for our team standup? (yes/no)



2. Are you willing to track your working hours in Hubstaff, screenshots and activity levels, for this role? (yes/no)



3. How many years have you personally worked US real estate DISPOSITIONS, meaning selling or assigning deals to end buyers? Answer with one of: none / lead gen only, 0-1, 2-3, 4-7, 8+.



4. What was your number in your last role? Give us the actual metric you were measured on and the actual figure you carried - deals assigned or sold per month, average assignment fee, days-on-market for your dispo, transactions managed at once, whatever it was. If you were never measured on a number, say so plainly. That is an acceptable answer, but say it.



5. Walk us through your buyers list. How did you build it from zero? How many buyers were on it, and how many of those actually bought more than once? What did you do to keep it warm? Be specific - where the names came from and how you sorted them.



6. You have a wholesale deal under contract. Closing is in 9 days. You have no end buyer, and the two who walked the property both went quiet. What do you do, day by day, for the next 9 days? Tell us what you would change, who you would call, and at what point you would tell the owner it is not going to sell.



7. Here is our real situation. We have zero deals with an under-contract date recorded and no deal board at all. Nobody is your subordinate - the two people who own the front of the pipeline sit beside you as peers. What do you do in your first week? Day by day.



8. You are reviewing a settlement statement the day before closing. The commission line is calculated on a sales price that is higher than the contract price printed on the same page. What do you do, in what order, and who do you call?



Honest and specific beats polished. A short paragraph each is plenty.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
# Business Development & Prospecting Specialist



**DumpStor of Tulsa**



## Position Summary



The **Business Development & Prospecting Specialist** supports DumpStor of Tulsa's growth by identifying, contacting, qualifying, and cultivating prospective commercial customers and referral partners. The Specialist must be able to work U.S. Central time zone core business hours. Outbound calls must be made between 9:00am CT and 3:00pm CT. 



This is primarily an **outbound prospecting and lead-development role**, rather than a closing sales or dispatch position. The Specialist will work from DumpStor's Master Prospecting List, research new prospects, conduct outbound calls, identify businesses that use roll-off dumpsters, introduce DumpStor's services, send follow-up communications, maintain accurate prospect records, and route qualified opportunities to the appropriate DumpStor team member.



The goal of the position is to build a consistent pipeline of qualified business opportunities while providing every contact with a professional, friendly, low-pressure introduction to DumpStor of Tulsa.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Outbound Prospecting & Lead Qualification



* Conduct outbound calls to businesses identified on the DumpStor Master Prospecting List.

* Introduce DumpStor of Tulsa and its dumpster rental services using approved messaging and scripts.

* Determine whether businesses use roll-off dumpsters and, when applicable, gather information regarding:



  * How dumpsters are used, including job sites, permanent locations, or both.

  * Dumpster sizes typically used.

  * Approximate frequency of rentals.

  * Current dumpster provider, when voluntarily disclosed.

  * Satisfaction with the current provider.

  * Potential interest in an alternative or backup provider.

  * Upcoming projects or potential rental needs.

* Identify the individual responsible for coordinating dumpster rentals or vendor relationships and obtain accurate contact information.

* Recognize and appropriately route high-potential commercial opportunities.



### Prospect Research



* Research potential commercial customers within DumpStor's service area.

* Identify new businesses within designated target industries, including construction, remodeling/restoration, roofing, flooring, property management, real estate, landscaping, siding/windows, countertops/cabinets, cannabis businesses, and other approved categories.

* Gather available company information, including business name, address, telephone number, website, business category, and appropriate contact information.

* Add qualified prospects to the Master Prospecting List in accordance with DumpStor procedures.

* Avoid duplicate records and maintain accurate, usable prospect information.



### Prospect Follow-Up & Relationship Development



* Conduct scheduled follow-up calls with previously contacted prospects according to established priority and callback protocols.

* Position DumpStor as a potential primary or backup dumpster provider when appropriate.

* Maintain professional relationships with prospects who may not have an immediate need but represent future business opportunities.

* Use approved promotional and referral offers when applicable.

* Respect established vendor relationships and maintain a consultative, non-aggressive approach.

* Immediately honor requests not to receive additional prospecting calls.



###
 Follow-Up



* Send approved follow-up
s after prospecting conversations when appropriate.

* Provide approved DumpStor brochures, pricing information, promotional offers, and other materials.

* Personalize approved templates based on the substance of the conversation without making unauthorized commitments or representations.

* Ensure follow-up communications are completed promptly and accurately documented.



### Prospect Tracking & Documentation



Maintain complete and accurate information in the DumpStor Master Prospecting List, including:



* Call attempts and dates.

* Contact and decision-maker information.

* Call disposition.

* Dumpster usage and frequency.

* Current provider information when available.

* Prospect priority/status.

* Follow-up
s sent.

* Promotional offers provided.

* Next action and next-action date.

* Internal routing or handoff.

* Relevant notes from conversations.



A prospecting interaction is not considered complete until the required documentation, follow-up communication, next action, and internal routing have been completed.



### Lead Classification & Routing



Classify prospects according to DumpStor's established system:



* **Red:** High-priority or immediate opportunity.

* **Orange:** Qualified prospect with legitimate potential but no immediate purchasing signal.

* **Yellow:** Longer-term or lower-frequency opportunity.

* **Gray:** Business/referral relationship that is not currently a meaningful dumpster prospect.

* **Green:** Existing DumpStor customer.



Route prospects according to established procedures:



* **Ali/Dispatch:** Account setup, routine backup-provider relationship, Docket-related setup, booking, scheduling, and operational questions.

* **Audrey/Allen:** High-value prospects, recurring commercial opportunities, pricing negotiations, strategic relationships, dissatisfied competitor customers, or prospects requiring customized solutions.



### Reporting & Performance Tracking



Provide accurate activity and pipeline information for DumpStor's weekly prospecting scorecard, including:



* Calls attempted.

* Unique businesses contacted.

* Live contacts.

* Decision-makers reached.

* Follow-up
s sent.

* New prospects researched and added.

* Dumpster users identified.

* Qualified opportunities.

* Backup-provider opportunities.

* Promotional offers made.

* Red, Orange, and Yellow leads generated.

* Leads routed to Ali.

* Leads routed to Audrey/Allen.

* Scheduled callbacks.

* Do-not-call requests.

* Other agreed-upon prospecting metrics.



Work with DumpStor to ensure reported activity reconciles with information maintained in the Master Prospecting List.



## Approved Sales Authority



The Business Development & Prospecting Specialist may:



* Explain DumpStor's approved products and services.

* Quote approved standard pricing.

* Communicate approved rental terms and included tonnage.

* Explain approved additional charges.

* Offer approved promotional codes to eligible prospects.

* Explain DumpStor's service area.

* Discuss approved features and benefits.

* Position DumpStor as a primary or backup dumpster provider.



The Specialist **may not independently**:



* Negotiate commercial or contractor pricing.

* Offer unauthorized discounts.

* Modify promotional offers.

* Waive established fees.

* Guarantee delivery or pickup times without confirmation.

* Promise availability.

* Agree to contract terms on behalf of DumpStor.

* Make exceptions to service-area, waste, placement, or other operational requirements.

* Make representations about DumpStor's services that are not contained in approved materials.



Questions or opportunities outside established authority must be referred to the appropriate DumpStor representative.



## Customer Service Expectations



The Specialist serves as a representative of DumpStor of Tulsa and is expected to:



* Communicate in a friendly, professional, confident, and conversational manner.

* Treat prospects as potential long-term relationships rather than simply names on a calling list.

* Avoid aggressive or high-pressure sales tactics.

* Respect businesses that are satisfied with their current providers.

* Never criticize or disparage competitors.

* Provide accurate information and never guess when an answer is unknown.

* Clearly distinguish confirmed information from items requiring DumpStor approval.

* Protect confidential company, customer, and prospect information.

* Maintain accurate records of all substantive communications.



DumpStor's approach should be:



**"We don't need to replace a provider who is serving you well. We'd simply like the opportunity to become another resource you can call when you need us."**



## Desired Qualifications



The ideal Business Development & Prospecting Specialist will have:



* Experience in outbound calling, business development, appointment setting, lead generation, customer service, or a similar role.

* Strong telephone communication and interpersonal skills.

* Comfort speaking with business owners, contractors, office managers, project managers, and other decision-makers.

* Ability to ask questions and listen rather than simply read a sales script.

* Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

* Accurate data-entry and documentation habits.

* Ability to manage scheduled callbacks and multiple prospect relationships.

* Comfort conducting basic online business research.

* Professional written communication skills.

* Ability to learn and accurately communicate pricing, service information, and business procedures.

* Sound judgment regarding when an opportunity should be escalated.

* Ability to work independently while following established processes and scripts.



Experience working with contractors, construction businesses, home services, property management, waste services, or other B2B service businesses is helpful but not required.



## Performance Expectations



Performance will be evaluated based on both **activity and quality**, rather than call volume alone.



Key indicators may include:



* Consistent outbound prospecting activity.

* Quality and accuracy of prospect research.

* Decision-maker contact rate.

* Number and quality of qualified prospects generated.

* Backup-provider opportunities developed.

* High-priority leads generated.

* Timeliness and quality of follow-up.

* Accuracy of prospect records.

* Adherence to callback schedules.

* Quality of internal handoffs.

* Prospect-to-customer conversions tracked by DumpStor.

* Contribution to new and recurring commercial business.



The Specialist is expected to focus on developing a **quality business-development pipeline**, not simply maximizing the number of calls made.



## Working Relationship



The Business Development & Prospecting Specialist will work closely with DumpStor of Tulsa's owners and dispatch team. DumpStor will provide approved prospecting materials, scripts, pricing information, service-area information, promotional offers, follow-up templates, and access to the Master Prospecting List.



The Specialist is responsible for following DumpStor's established procedures and promptly communicating significant opportunities, customer concerns, questions, or issues requiring internal attention.

title: Mechanical / HVAC Analyst
description:
This role supports a US-based mechanical and plumbing contractor from a fully remote desk. A field team visits properties and gathers equipment data - photos, nameplates, specifications - and sends it to you. From there the analysis is yours. You review the existing equipment, assess the proposed replacement, and work out the efficiency improvement using BTU, kilowatt and therm based calculations. You then research what the relevant utility rebate program requires, interpret its rules, and determine whether the project qualifies and at what value. The output is a detailed report in a shared spreadsheet, a centralized database tracking project and permit status kept current, and help preparing the permit paperwork itself. The work starts with the PSE&G program in New Jersey and expands into more programs and more states over time. The technical foundation is what matters most: you need to genuinely understand how these systems operate, because the calculations are yours to carry and there is nobody sitting next to you to check them.



What you’ll do

Review equipment specifications for boilers, heating, hot water and cooling systems from field photos and data

Assess existing and proposed equipment and calculate the efficiency improvement

Perform BTU, kilowatt and therm based calculations across different fuel types and efficiency ratings

Research and interpret utility rebate program requirements

Determine whether a project qualifies for a rebate and estimate the amount

Prepare detailed reports in shared spreadsheets

Maintain a centralized database tracking project and permit status

Assist with permit paperwork preparation

Work independently from field data without day-to-day supervision



What we’re looking for

Strong hands-on HVAC and mechanical systems experience - boilers, heating, hot water and cooling

Genuine understanding of how heating, cooling and hot water systems actually operate

Working knowledge of BTUs, kilowatts, therms, fuel types and equipment efficiency ratings

Ability to compare existing against proposed equipment and calculate efficiency improvements

Ability to research a utility rebate program and analyse whether a project qualifies

Strong analytical and calculation skills

Advanced spreadsheet skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Report preparation and documentation

Experience maintaining project or permit status databases

Permit paperwork preparation

Comfortable working US working hours



Nice to have

Prior experience with utility rebate programs, whether PSE&G or another US utility

Familiarity with energy or rebate programs across several US states

Experience supporting US-based contractors or mechanical and plumbing companies remotely

You will manage house account projects for a door manufacturer and supplier, from the initial quote through to completion, coordinating internal teams, customers, designers, manufacturers and suppliers along the way. What makes it technical rather than administrative is the review work. Customers and designers send in specifications, and a large part of this job is reading them critically: is the hardware appropriate for the door weight, does the machining make sense, can this configuration actually be built and installed as drawn. Catching a problem at that stage costs a phone call. Missing it costs a manufacturing run. You will also handle high volume quoting, accurate order processing, sourcing from suppliers and manufacturers, and rigorous tracking across several live projects at once. And you will act as the technical advisor in the room: explaining limitations, recommending alternatives, and asking the right questions when a specification is incomplete or contradictory, to technical and non technical people alike.

Door hardware compatibility knowledge - hinges, closers, locks, frames and machining

I will give you a niche, industry, country, or business idea, and you will be responsible for researching it deeply and presenting accurate, organized, and useful information.

Minimum 1–2 years of proven online/market research experience

Strong Google and advanced web research skills

Competitor research

Company & lead research

Pricing research

Experience researching through LinkedIn

Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills

Ability to find companies, owners and decision-makers

Ability to find publicly available business contact information

Ability to verify important information from multiple sources

Excellent attention to detail

Good written English (B2/C1+ preferred)

Ability to work independently without detailed instructions for every task

Ability to clearly summarize findings and recommendations

AI Usage

You may use ChatGPT and other AI tools to help with research.

However:

❌ Copy-pasting AI answers is NOT acceptable

❌ Unverified information is NOT acceptable

❌ Fake companies, contacts, prices or statistics are NOT acceptable

Important findings must include real sources/links.

Example of Your Work

I may give you a task such as:

“Research the roofing industry in the UK.”

You should be able to independently research:

Market and niche opportunities

Competitors

Services offered

Typical pricing

Potential companies/clients

Company websites

Owners/decision-makers

Publicly available contact information

Problems businesses in the niche are facing

Potential services we could offer them

Opportunities worth exploring

At the end of every research task, I expect a short conclusion:

What did you find?

What has the most potential?

What do you recommend we do next?

DO NOT APPLY IF:

You have no previous research experience

Your main experience is only data entry

You depend entirely on ChatGPT

You don't verify your information

You cannot work independently

You need step-by-step instructions for every research task

How to Apply

Please include:

Your previous research experience

How many years you have worked in research

Industries/niches you have researched

Research tools you use

Your Google Sheets/Excel experience

Your hourly or monthly rate

An example of previous research you have completed

PAID TEST

Shortlisted candidates will receive a small paid research test before being hired.

We will evaluate:

Accuracy • Research Depth • Sources • Organization • Speed • Independent Thinking

Applications without relevant research experience or examples may not be considered.

title: Courtroom Clip Sourcing Specialist
description:
Job Brief: Courtroom Clip Sourcing Specialist



 About NFQ

NFQ is a courtroom **compilation** channel — not a case-analysis or legal-news channel. Think viral courtroom moments stitched into fast-paced, entertaining videos: defendants who think they're smarter than the judge, arrogant attitudes that flip the second a sentence is read, sovereign-citizen arguments getting shut down, probation hearings that go sideways, emotional victim confrontations, and outbursts that end in deputies stepping in.



Every video is a **compilation of 10–12 standalone clips**, running roughly **20–25 minutes**. Each clip has to work on its own — a complete mini-story with a beginning, a turn, and a payoff — regardless of the surrounding case context.



The goal is to get NFQ monetized as quickly as possible, so the sourcing pipeline needs to move fast without sacrificing clip quality.



 Reference / Inspiration Channels

These channels are doing the format well — the researcher should study their content, clip selection, pacing, and video structure before sourcing:

- Courtroom Consequences — 

- The Decoder Production — 

- Courtroom — 

- Women of Crime — 

- Crime360 by A&E — 

- Court On Cam Official — 

- Courtroom Unfiltered — 

- Bars and Justice — 

- Court Analysis — 

- Courtroom Verdict — 



---



 Role: Courtroom Clip Sourcing Specialist



**Reports to:** Head of Content / Content Lead

**Type:** [Full-time / Part-time / Freelance — specify]

**Location:** [Remote / Hybrid / On-site — specify]

**Compensation:** [$X–$Y per hour, or per-clip rate — specify]



 Role Summary

The Courtroom Clip Sourcer finds, watches, and logs the raw courtroom moments that become NFQ's compilation videos. This is not about summarizing a case — it's about hunting for the exact seconds of footage that make someone stop scrolling: the argument, the reaction, the consequence. The quality and volume of what this person finds directly determines how fast NFQ can publish and grow.



### What Kind of Clips We're Looking For

We are **not** looking for random court hearings. Every clip needs a clear, entertaining moment or payoff that can hold attention inside a compilation — driven by conflict, emotion, surprise, consequences, or an unexpected reaction.



Examples of what we want:

- Defendant argues with the judge → judge warns them → defendant keeps going → gets contempt or additional punishment.

- Defendant thinks they're going home → judge announces a prison sentence → visible shock or reaction.

- Arrogant defendant laughs or smirks → attitude changes once the sentence is announced.

- Judge completely loses patience after repeatedly warning a difficult defendant.

- Defendant begs or breaks down realizing how serious the sentence is.

- Defendant insults or disrespects the judge and immediately faces consequences.

- Bond hearing goes horribly wrong → defendant says or does something → judge raises or revokes bond.

- Probation violation hearing where someone talks themselves into jail.

- Sovereign citizen defendant argues with the judge and gets shut down.

- Defendant gets caught lying because the judge or prosecutor already has contradicting evidence.

- Unexpected confession or admission happens while the defendant is speaking.

- Defendant celebrates too early, before realizing the judge or prosecutor isn't finished.

- Courtroom outburst — yelling, threats, storming off, restraint by deputies, etc.

- Physical courtroom i
, such as an attempted attack on a judge, lawyer, witness, or defendant.

- Emotional victim-impact confrontation with a notable defendant reaction.

- Family member confronts the defendant during sentencing.

- Judge delivers an unusually powerful speech before sentencing.

- Defendant represents themselves and creates an extraordinary exchange.

- Judge recognizes a repeat offender or realizes they've dealt with this defendant before.

- Defendant refuses the judge's advice and immediately makes things worse.



 What Makes a GOOD Clip

Every clip should be a mini-story: **SETUP → TENSION → MOMENT → CONSEQUENCE**.



**Good example:** Defendant is facing a probation violation → judge offers another chance → defendant becomes disrespectful → judge changes course and sends them to jail. That's a complete arc — use it.



**Not good enough:** Defendant sits quietly → lawyer speaks for four minutes → judge schedules another hearing. Even if the underlying case is serious, if nothing entertaining happens on camera, it's not usable.



**The test:** *"If I removed all narration, is there still something in this clip people would want to watch?"* If yes, it's a fit for NFQ.



 Key Responsibilities

- Watch full hearings/footage directly — never select a clip based on a title, headline, or article alone.

- Source raw footage from public court broadcasts, livestreams, and archives, and discover leads via reference channels, Court TV, Law&Crime, news articles, Reddit, TikTok, etc. — but always track down the original/full courtroom source whenever possible.

- Identify the exact best moment within each hearing, not just the general case.

- Log every clip recommendation in this format:

  - **Full hearing:** [source/link]

  - **Watch:** 37:42–40:18 (full relevant window)

  - **Best moment:** 39:03–40:18 (the tightest usable cut)

  - **What happens:** short factual description of the moment

  - **Why it's good:** what makes it entertaining (escalation, reaction, consequence, etc.)

- Deliver a steady supply toward the target of **10–12 strong clips per video**, with videos running **20–25 minutes** total.

- Maintain a shared tracker/database of sourced clips with status (new, in review, approved, rejected, published).

- Build and maintain a running list of reliable sources and channels for future sourcing.

- Flag any footage involving minors, sealed proceedings, or otherwise sensitive circumstances (e.g., sexual assault cases, ongoing sensitive investigations) for editorial review before use.

- Verify footage comes from a public/open proceeding and confirm usage rights before flagging it for editing.

- Collaborate with editors and the content lead on which clips to prioritize.



 Requirements

- Strong research skills and comfort navigating YouTube, court archives, livestreams, and social platforms (Reddit, TikTok, etc.) to find leads.

- Willingness and patience to actually watch full hearings, not just skim titles/articles.

- A sharp eye for pacing, escalation, and payoff — this is an entertainment instinct, not just a research skill.

- Meticulous attention to detail — accurate timestamps and source logging are non-negotiable.

- Basic understanding of what footage is legally usable (public proceedings) vs. restricted.

- Comfortable working independently and hitting a daily/weekly clip quota.

- Familiarity with spreadsheet or database tools (Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, etc.).



 Nice to Have

- Existing familiarity with the courtroom-compilation genre (channels like the ones listed above).

- Background or coursework in journalism, paralegal studies, or media production.

- Basic video editing familiarity (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve) — helpful for clean handoff to editors, not required.

- An existing list of go-to sources or a network for finding viral courtroom i
 early.



 What Success Looks Like

- A steady pipeline of well-documented, rights-clear clips that consistently hit the SETUP → TENSION → MOMENT → CONSEQUENCE bar.

- Enough volume to support 10–12 clips per 20–25 minute video, on a reliable schedule.

- Few to no compliance issues (e.g., footage that shouldn't have been used).

- Clips that perform well because they were chosen for real entertainment value, not just because the underlying case was serious.

title: CRM & Workflow Automation Specialist
description:
Property Investor App is looking for an experienced CRM & Workflow Automation Specialist to take ownership of our customer journeys, automations and engagement workflows.



This is NOT a general VA or basic
 marketing role.



We want someone who understands customer behaviour and can answer:



“The customer has done X — what should happen next?”



What You'll Be Doing



We have a large database of UK property investors who register, open
s, view properties, make enquiries and interact with our platform in different ways.



Your role will be to analyse these behaviours and create intelligent automated workflows around them.



Examples:



1. New customer registers but doesn't open the welcome
 → what happens next?

2. Customer opens
s but doesn't log in → how do we engage them?

3. Customer views 5+ properties but doesn't enquire → should we follow up?

4. Customer repeatedly views HMOs → should their communication change?

5. Customer hasn't logged in for 30/60/90 days → how do we reactivate them?

6. Customer clicks a property from a marketing
 → what happens next?

7. Highly engaged customer → when should our team personally contact them?



You will help us build:



Registration → Onboarding → Engagement → Enquiry → Conversion → Retention → Reactivation



Your Responsibilities



You will:



1. Map and improve existing customer journeys

2. Build automated CRM/email workflows

3. Create behaviour-based triggers and follow-ups

4. Segment customers based on activity and interests

5. Improve onboarding and reactivation

6. Plan
 sequences and follow-ups

7. Analyse opens, clicks, property views, enquiries and conversions

8. A/B test workflows and messaging

9. Identify gaps where customers are not being followed up

10. Recommend new workflows based on customer data



We want someone who proactively finds opportunities, rather than waiting to be told what workflow to build.



Experience We're Looking For



You should have real hands-on experience with CRM, lifecycle or marketing automation.



Experience with platforms such as:



ActiveCampaign / HubSpot / 
 / GoHighLevel / Klaviyo / Make / Zapier or similar is useful, but your ability to design good workflows is more important than knowing a particular platform.



Ideally, you have 2+ years' experience in CRM automation, lifecycle marketing, marketing operations, SaaS/customer engagement or similar.



Please Don't Apply If...



Your experience is mainly:



- General VA work

- Sending newsletters

- Basic Mailchimp campaigns

- Simple Zapier automations

- Courses without real commercial experience



We are specifically looking for someone who has personally built and improved customer automation workflows.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



PIA WORKFLOW 26



Then answer ONLY these 3 questions:



1. Show us something you've built.

Describe ONE real customer workflow you personally created.

What triggered it? What happened next? What software did you use? What result did it achieve?

Where possible, include an anonymised screenshot, workflow diagram or Loom video showing your work.



2. Solve this problem.

A new PIA customer opens our welcome
 and then views 9 investment properties over 7 days but makes no enquiry.

What would you make happen next?

Keep your answer short. We want to understand how you think, not receive a long essay.



3. What tools have you actually used?

List the CRM/automation platforms you have personally worked with and rate yourself:

Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced

Also tell us your expected monthly salary in PHP.



Important



Please don't send us a generic cover letter.



We don't care about perfectly written applications. We care about evidence, experience and how you think.



Shortlisted candidates will have a video interview and may be given a small paid practical workflow exercise before we make our final decision.



We are looking for someone who can ultimately own the customer journey and workflow strategy within Property Investor App.



If that's you, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Administrative and Operations Assistant
description:
About MF Digital

MF Digital is a specialized digital marketing agency that helps law schools and graduate programs increase enrollment.



We are hiring a highly organized, proactive Administrative Assistant to support our Managing Director and team and help keep projects, communications, meetings, and administrative work organized and moving forward.



This is a hands-on role for someone who is excellent at follow-through. You will work closely with our Operations team, Managing Director, Project Manager, and other team members. You'll use Basecamp, our project management tool, to help document and track work, and you'll gradually take on greater responsibility as you learn the company, our clients, and our processes.



The right person will not simply wait for instructions. We are looking for someone who pays attention, keeps track of details, follows up professionally, and notices when something needs attention.



Key Responsibilities:



Administrative & Project Support

- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Managing Director and team

- Organize documents, files, information, and internal resources

- Prepare and format reports, presentations, and client-facing materials

- Assist with recurring administrative tasks and special projects

- Keep assigned responsibilities organized and follow through on deadlines

- Coordinate with team members, contractors, and vendors when needed



Meetings & Follow-Up

- Attend selected internal and client meetings during U.S. business hours

- Take clear and accurate meeting notes

- Capture decisions, requests, deadlines, action items, and next steps

- Help ensure meeting follow-ups are documented and completed

- Create, assign, and update relevant tasks in Basecamp

- Follow up with team members on outstanding action items



You will initially work closely with our Operations team to learn how client meetings, project information, and follow-ups are handled at MF Digital.



Managing Director Support

As you become familiar with the company and its projects, an important part of the role will be helping our Managing Director stay organized and focused.



Responsibilities include:

- Reviewing designated projects and compiling items requiring the Managing Director's attention

- Tracking outstanding requests and action items

- Helping identify client communications that are awaiting a response

- Preparing daily or weekly lists of priorities and follow-ups

- Gathering and organizing information needed for decisions

- Coordinating meetings and related follow-up

- Following up with team members on requests and outstanding work

- Helping make sure important commitments and deadlines do not fall through the cracks



Basecamp & Project Coordination

Basecamp is MF Digital's primary project management tool. You will use it regularly as part of your work.



Depending on the project and responsibility, you may:

- Create and assign tasks

- Update task details, deadlines, and next steps

- Document information and decisions from meetings

- Review assigned projects for outstanding items

- Follow up on overdue or incomplete tasks

- Help keep project information accurate and organized

- Coordinate with our Operations team and Project Manager



This position supports our existing project-management and operations structure rather than independently owning it.



Client & Marketing Support

- Help prepare client-facing presentations and other materials

- Support client onboarding and kickoff activities when needed

- Assist with coordination for occasional client video shoots and other special projects

- Help ensure client requests and follow-ups are documented and routed to the appropriate person



Recruiting & Team Support

- Assist with recruiting and applicant-screening administration

- Help organize candidate information and application materials

- Coordinate interviews and candidate follow-ups when needed

- Support administrative aspects of onboarding new contractors and team members

- Maintain recruiting and onboarding documentation as assigned



Events, Vendors & Special Projects

Depending on current company needs, you may also assist our Operations team with:

- Conference and event coordination

- Vendor communication and follow-up

- Client video-shoot coordination

- Troubleshooting and tracking outstanding vendor issues

- Preparing materials for special projects

- Other administrative and coordination needs that arise



Some of these responsibilities are shared with or owned by other team members. Your role will be to provide support and coordination where needed rather than automatically assuming ownership of every function.



What We're Looking For

- At least 3 years of experience in administrative assistance, executive assistance, project coordination, account support, operations support, or a similar role

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

- Excellent follow-through

- Ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and deadlines simultaneously

- Ability to turn meetings and conversations into clear notes and action items

- Confidence communicating professionally with U.S.-based clients and senior team members

- Comfortable following up persistently and professionally when something is outstanding

- Good judgment about when to handle something independently and when to ask questions or escalate an issue

- Ability to learn a company's clients, processes, systems, and ways of working

- Experience with Basecamp or another project-management platform

- Proficiency with Google Workspace and spreadsheet data



Experience with a marketing agency, digital marketing company, professional-services organization, or higher-education organization is a plus, but not required.



The Right Person

You are someone who naturally keeps track of details.



When a meeting ends, you know what was d
, who needs to do what, and what needs to happen next.



When someone says they'll take care of something, you remember to check whether it actually happened.



When information is scattered across conversations, meetings, and projects, you can organize it into something useful.



You are comfortable asking questions when something is unclear and following up when something is overdue. At the same time, you understand that good support requires judgment—not every issue needs to be escalated, and not every responsibility needs to be taken over.



You are dependable, resourceful, professional, and interested in understanding how the business works rather than simply completing a list of assigned tasks.



Please begin your application subject line with the words “MF Admin” so we know you read the complete posting.



Work Schedule

This is a full-time position requiring consistent availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.



Candidates based in the Philippines must be comfortable working an overnight schedule.



How to Apply

Please submit:

- A brief introduction explaining why this role fits your experience

- Your résumé

- Your desired hourly or monthly compensation

- Confirmation that you can consistently work full-time U.S. Central Time hours

Please end your application subject line with the words “star” so we know you read the complete posting.

title: Creative Strategist / Direct-Response Copywriter — US Health Brand ($10/hr, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US



We're a US direct-to-consumer health supplement brand, scaling fast. We sell to a skeptical, older American audience — people 55 to 75 who have a drawer full of supplements that promised everything and delivered nothing. Winning their trust is hard. That's the job.



We run aggressive direct-response creative on Meta: video ads, UGC scripts, native advertorials, static ads.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Research our buyer until you know them better than they know themselves — their exact language, their fears, what almost stopped them from buying

Study competitor ads in the Meta Ad Library and work out WHY the winners win. Not what they say — why it works.

Propose which angles and ads we build next, with the reasoning and the data behind it

Write the scripts: video briefs, UGC, native advertorials (800–1500 words), static concepts

Read performance data and tell me what it means

Flag when we need a landing page or an
 angle — and propose the structure



You are the thinking mind of the creative. You propose the play. You don't wait to be told the play.



REQUIREMENTS — all of these, not most of them



Minimum 2 years writing direct-response copy. Not brand copy. Not blog posts. Not social captions. Copy written to sell, where you saw the numbers afterward.

You can write a full long-form advertorial — 1000+ words that hold a reader who didn't intend to read anything. If you've only written short-form, you're not ready for this role.

You understand the metrics. ROAS, CAC, payback period, LTV, MER, hold rate. Not as vocabulary — as things you've used to make a decision.

You can tell a symptom from a story. "I get tired in the afternoon" is a symptom. "I promised my granddaughter I'd be at her birthday, and I made it forty minutes before I went and sat in the car" is a story. If that distinction isn't instantly obvious to you, please don't apply.

You follow instructions precisely. If I ask for five pieces, I get five. If I ask for a scene, I get a scene. This is the single most common reason people don't last here.

Strong written English. Native fluency isn't required. Precision is. If your application has sloppy errors, that's the answer.

You take feedback once. I'll correct something once, clearly. I won't correct it three times.



DO NOT APPLY IF



You need every task explained twice

You use AI to write and hope nobody notices

You go quiet when you're stuck instead of asking

You want to write "nice" content. Our register is aggressive. If your draft feels safe and could belong to any supplement brand, it's wrong.

You're juggling five other clients and this is filler



WHAT YOU GET



$8-10/hour, 4 hours a day to start, Monday to Friday. More hours available as you prove out.

Long-term. We're building a team, not filling a gap.

Real training, real feedback, access to our real performance data

You'll learn direct-response at a level most people never get exposed to



HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. Most applicants won't, and that's the first filter.



1. Start your application with the word HYDROGEN in the subject line. No HYDROGEN, no reply.



2. Answer these three questions. Short is fine — thinking matters more than length:



What's the difference between an angle and a benefit? Give me one example of each.

Name one ad — any brand, any product — you think is genuinely well written, and tell me in two or three sentences why it works.

Why do most supplement ads fail with a skeptical 65-year-old buyer?



3. Write me ONE opening scene. Just one. Two or three sentences.



The person: a man, 62, who feels a lot older than he is. He's low on energy by mid-afternoon and has written it off as age.



Do NOT describe his tiredness. Write the 
nt it cost him something. A specific person, a specific place, a specific 
nt, and something he lost. Do not use the words "tired," "energy," or "exhausted" anywhere.



4. Send one writing sample of long-form direct-response copy you wrote yourself. An advertorial, a sales page, a VSL script. If you don't have one, this role isn't a fit yet.



5. Tell me honestly whether you used AI for any part of this application. We can tell. An honest yes is far better than a no we don't believe. AI-written applications go straight in the bin.



We reply to every application that completes all five steps. We don't reply to the ones that don't.

title: Executive Assistant to Founder (US Company) — Full-time, Remote
description:
About Us



We're a US-based strategy consultancy. We work with companies on positioning and market strategy, and we also run a paid membership community for professionals in our field. Both are extensions of our founder, which means this role sits close to the center of how the business actually runs, not on its periphery.



A note on discretion: we've kept our company and founder details out of this post on purpose. Our founder has a public profile, and we'd rather run a quiet search than a public one. We'll share who we are in full at the interview stage, and you'll be talking to real people on video well before any commitment is asked of you. Discretion is a core part of this job, so we're starting as we mean to go on.



The Role



We're hiring a strategic partner and right hand to the founder: someone who becomes an extension of how they think, operate, and show up in the world. This isn't a role defined by a fixed task list. It's defined by a standing relationship. You'll be trusted with the judgment calls, instructions, the things that need to happen without being asked twice, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks, and the follow-through that makes their time and attention go further.



Concretely, that means you'll move fluidly across four kinds of responsibility: protecting their time and attention, running the operational backbone of the business, representing their voice externally, and acting as an early-warning system for anything that needs their judgment before it becomes a problem.



The specific tasks will shift week to week. What won't shift is the level of trust, ownership, and proximity to the founder that the role carries.



The Kinds of Responsibility You'll Carry



- Guardian of their time and focus. You'll own the calendar and inbox not as scheduling mechanics, but as an exercise in judgment: knowing what deserves their attention, what can be handled without them, and what needs to be reframed before it reaches them.

- Operator of the business backbone. Payroll, compliance, contracts, vendor relationships, insurance, and account access all run through you. You're the person who makes sure the business doesn't trip over its own administration.

- Extension of their voice. You'll draft and send communications under their name, coordinate their public presence (content, speaking engagements, newsletter), and represent them accurately and well when they're not in the room.

- Partner in the community they've built. Supporting the parts of the membership community that depend on their personal relationships: speaker relationships and high-value member and prospect conversations.

- Trusted with the personal alongside the professional. A limited but real slice of the role touches personal logistics, in coordination with existing household support.



This is deliberately broad. The person who thrives here won't be looking for a checklist. They'll be looking for a role that grows in scope as trust builds, the same way it did for the person who held this seat before you.



You Might Be a Fit If You...



- Have been the right hand to a founder or executive before, and know that the job is really about judgment, not just execution.

- Can hold financial, legal, and personal responsibility (payroll, compliance, account access) with real accuracy and discretion.

- Write well enough that people can't tell where your draft ends and the founder's voice begins.

- Like building the systems and documentation that make a business less dependent on any one person's memory, including your own.

- Want a role that expands with you, not one that stays the same size for three years.



Required



- 3+ years in a senior Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, or Operations Manager role supporting a founder or executive. Not general VA work.

- Demonstrated ownership of process-heavy administrative work (e.g., payroll, compliance, or similar systems) with high accuracy.

- Strong written English. You'll be drafting and sending communications under someone else's name and voice.

- Track record of managing multiple concurrent workstreams independently with minimal supervision.

- Discretion with sensitive financial, legal, and personal information.

- Stable internet and a reliable computer.



Strongly Preferred



- Experience with Gusto or a comparable payroll/HR platform, including US multi-state compliance.

- Comfort with content and media tools (Notion, Slack, basic video and social scheduling tools).

- Experience supporting a public-facing founder, creator, or executive with an active media presence.

- Familiarity with vendor and event logistics.



This role is not for



- Anyone currently holding another full-time job. This is a full-time seat.

- Agencies or teams applying on behalf of staff. We're hiring one person.



Working Style



- Highly organized and process-oriented. Able to build and document systems, not just execute tasks.

- Responsive and available for time-sensitive requests, including some evening and weekend flexibility around events and travel.

- Trustworthy with financial and legal responsibility, and comfortable being the last check before something goes out.



Our Hiring Process



1. Written application (below)

2. Preliminary video interview

3. Final video call with the founder

4. Offer, followed by a full handover period with the current EA before he leaves



How to Apply

Send all four of the items below. Applications missing any part won't be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the word PARTNER so we know you read this post properly.

2. Your resume.

3. A short note (200 to 400 words) on a time you operated as someone's right hand: a system, relationship, or judgment call you owned end to end, and how you made it work. Write it yourself, in your own words. We're reading for how you think and how you write, not for polish.

4. A video of yourself, 2 minutes maximum, answering: why this role, and what part of it are you least experienced in? Please don't script or edit it. We'd rather see you talk normally than watch a rehearsed pitch. A phone camera is completely fine.



We review applications as they come in and will reply to everyone who follows the instructions above.

Direct experience with Canadian sales tax is welcome but not essential - if you have worked with VAT or a similar system, the concepts transfer. What matters far more is that you can carry this volume across several companies without losing accuracy, and hit recurring payroll and month-end deadlines on your own. This is a fully remote position for a candidate based in the Philippines, working U.S. business hours.

title: Director of Sales & Operations
description:
We are looking for a highly motivated, organized, and experienced **Director of Sales & Operations**.



This is a hands-on position responsible for managing our **seller and buyer leads from initial contact through the preparation of the business for sale**.



You will personally contact leads, book appointments, conduct discovery calls, gather information, manage follow-up, and use our AI systems to prepare business valuations and Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs).



This is NOT an entry-level position. We need someone who is comfortable talking to business owners, understands sales, follows up aggressively, stays organized, and can use technology and AI to get things done quickly.



## Core Responsibilities



### Seller Leads



* Contact every new seller lead promptly.

* Call, text, and follow up consistently until contact is made.

* Schedule seller appointments.

* Conduct initial discovery and qualification calls.

* Ask detailed questions about the seller and the business.

* Gather revenue, profit, expenses, owner involvement, employees, assets, leases, customer information, growth opportunities, reason for selling, timeline, and other important information.

* Request and collect financial statements and required documentation.

* Keep sellers moving through the process.

* Make sure no seller lead falls through the cracks.



### Buyer Leads



* Contact every buyer lead.

* Schedule buyer appointments.

* Qualify buyers based on experience, financial ability, available cash, financing, industry preferences, location, timeline, and acquisition criteria.

* Determine what type of business the buyer is looking to purchase.

* Make sure NDAs and required documents are completed before confidential information is released.

* Match qualified buyers with appropriate listings.

* Maintain consistent follow-up with active buyers.

* Track buyers who may be a fit for future listings.



### Business Valuations



You will use our established systems and AI tools to help prepare business valuations.



Responsibilities include:



* Review seller financial information.

* Identify potential add-backs.

* Calculate and review SDE and EBITDA when appropriate.

* Research industry multiples.

* Use our AI systems to assist with valuation analysis.

* Identify missing or questionable financial information.

* Prepare the valuation for internal review.

* Make sure the final valuation is logical, complete, and professional.



**AI will do much of the heavy lifting, but you are responsible for the quality and accuracy of the information being entered and reviewed.**



### CIM Preparation



You will use our AI systems to prepare Confidential Information Memorandums for businesses being marketed for sale.



This includes:



* Gathering information from the seller.

* Reviewing financial information.

* Preparing the company overview.

* Documenting products and services.

* Identifying competitive advantages.

* Outlining staffing and owner responsibilities.

* Identifying growth opportunities.

* Organizing financial information.

* Reviewing the AI-generated CIM.

* Correcting errors and improving the final document.

* Following up with sellers when information is missing.



You are responsible for making sure every CIM is accurate, professional, and ready to be presented to qualified buyers.



## Operations Responsibilities



This position also helps manage the day-to-day operations surrounding our sales pipeline.



You will:



* Maintain and update the CRM daily.

* Track every buyer and seller lead.

* Make sure every lead has a status and next action.

* Track appointments and follow-ups.

* Make sure required documents are collected.

* Keep files and deal information organized.

* Identify stalled leads and deals.

* Coordinate with brokers, administrative staff, and management.

* Make sure deadlines and next steps are completed.

* Help improve systems, processes, and AI workflows.

* Identify problems before they become bigger problems.

* Keep management updated on the sales pipeline and operational issues.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



**This is NOT an entry-level position.**



Applicants MUST have previous sales experience.



You should have experience:



* Calling and communicating with leads.

* Qualifying prospects.

* Booking appointments.

* Conducting sales or discovery calls.

* Following up with prospects.

* Managing a sales pipeline.

* Working with a CRM or similar system.

* Handling multiple prospects at different stages of the sales process.



Experience in **business brokerage, real estate, B2B sales, financial services, M&A, business acquisitions, or other high-ticket sales** is a major plus.



**If you do not have previous sales experience, please do not apply.**



## Technology Requirements



* **Must have an iPhone.**

* Must be comfortable calling and texting leads from an iPhone.

* Must be comfortable learning and using AI.

* Must be comfortable working inside a CRM.

* Must be able to learn new technology quickly.

* Must be comfortable working in a highly technology-driven company.



## Who We Are Looking For



We want someone who:



* Is extremely organized.

* Is confident on the phone.

* Is comfortable talking to business owners.

* Is persistent without being pushy.

* Follows up consistently.

* Takes ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.

* Can manage multiple priorities at once.

* Pays attention to details.

* Is comfortable with numbers and financial information.

* Learns technology quickly.

* Understands that speed matters in sales.

* Can work independently.

* Is solution-oriented.

* Takes responsibility for results.



## How Success Will Be Measured



Performance will be measured by:



* Speed to lead.

* Percentage of leads contacted.

* Seller appointments booked.

* Buyer appointments booked.

* Appointment show rate.

* Seller conversion rate.

* Buyer qualification rate.

* Follow-up completion.

* Number of valuations completed.

* Number of CIMs completed.

* Turnaround time.

* CRM accuracy.

* Number of qualified opportunities moved forward.

* Overall organization of the buyer and seller pipeline.



## The Bottom Line



Your job is to make sure **nothing falls through the cracks.**



Every seller lead gets contacted.



Every buyer lead gets contacted.



Every qualified prospect gets an appointment.



Every appointment gets followed up with.



Every qualified seller gets moved toward a valuation and CIM.



Every qualified buyer gets matched with the right opportunities.



You will use AI to work faster, but you are ultimately responsible for making sure the work gets done correctly.



**If you are a strong salesperson who is highly organized, loves follow-up, is comfortable with technology and AI, and knows how to take ownership of a sales and operations pipeline, we want to hear from you.**

title: Full-Time Confirmation Specialist for Online School
description:
We're hiring a Confirmation Specialist to make sure every prospect who books a call with our team actually shows up. This is a text-only role. You won't be making phone calls. Your job is to confirm booked appointments and follow up on no-shows, all through text, following our proven scripts.



The moment a call gets booked in our CRM, you're on it. Speed matters here. The faster you reach out, the higher our show rate.



This is a full-time role and you need to be available seven days a week. Appointments get booked around the clock, and your job is to text prospects as soon as a booking hits the system, not hours later.



What You'll Do

Text every new booked appointment as soon as it comes in, following our confirmation scripts

Send reminder texts in the lead-up to each appointment (day-before, day-of, and pre-call reminders)

Text every no-show right after they miss their call and work to get them rebooked

Keep working a lead until they confirm, reschedule, or are clearly not interested

Manage the calendars for all closers across the organization, keeping every appointment accurate and up to date

Color-code appointments on the calendar so confirmed calls are always clearly marked and easy to spot at a glance

Once a call is marked Confirmed, never let that slot get booked over

Monitor the CRM closely so no incoming message ever goes unanswered or unnoticed

Log every text and outcome in HighLevel, and keep lead status updated in real time (Unconfirmed, Confirmed, No-Show, Rescheduled)

Follow our scripts closely, and flag anything that isn't landing so we can sharpen them

A Taste of the Work



Example reminder text: "Hey [name], just confirming you're still good for our call tomorrow at [time]? Let me know if anything's changed."



Example no-show text: "Hey [name], looks like we missed you on the call. Let me know if something came up and we can find a new time that works."



What Success Looks Like

Every new booking gets a confirmation text within minutes

Show rate improves month over month

No-show follow-up happens the same day, every time

Every closer's calendar is accurate, current, and color-coded so confirmed calls are obvious

No message in the CRM ever sits unanswered

HighLevel is always accurate and up to date

Who You Are

You write clean, clear, natural-sounding texts and can follow a script without sounding robotic

You've done appointment setting, confirmation, or customer service texting work before

Experience with HighLevel or a similar CRM is a big plus

You're detail-oriented and comfortable managing multiple calendars at once without letting anything slip

You're reliable and available seven days a week

You're organized enough to manage a high volume of conversations without letting anyone slip through

You're coachable and want to get better at the job every week

Schedule



Full-time, seven days a week. 



How to Apply



Please include a short video introduction with your application. Tell us a bit about yourself, your experience with appointment setting or CRM work, and why you'd be a good fit for this role. Ideally include screenshots or images of past text conversations with prospects/customers.

18. Write the description and add links to the full episode and

20. Set audience, turn on monetization, assign the playlist, schedule



REQUIREMENTS

- Hands-on with Opus Clip or a close equivalent (Vizard, Klap, Descript)

- Canva, working inside an existing brand kit. Thumbnails and IG covers.

- YouTube Studio: thumbnails, descriptions, cards, end screens, monetization settings

NOT FOR YOU IF

- You need the hook written for you

- You want to own strategy

PAY: $6-10/hr based on work quality and merit

title: Meta Creative Strategist - DTC Pet Brand (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Creative obsessives,



We’re a 7-figure DTC pet brand scaling on Meta, and we’re looking for a Direct Response Creative Strategist who knows how to find winners.



You should be someone who can go deep into a market, understand who we’re selling to, how they think, what they want, what they’re afraid of, what they’ve already tried, and the exact language they use to talk about their problems.



Then turn that research into angles, hooks, concepts, scripts, and ads that sell.



And when something wins, you don’t move on to the next random idea.



You figure out why it won and find 10 ways to make it win again.



This is not a video editing role.



This is not a social media content role.



This is not a brand design role.



This is not a junior media buying role.



We already have video editors and designers. We’re hiring the person who tells them what to create, why we’re creating it, and what we should test next.



We’re looking for someone who lives in the overlap between customer psychology, creative and performance.



Die zin “We already have video editors…” vind ik hier belangrijker dan alleen “this is not a video editing role”. Een editor die de vacature scant begrijpt dan direct: oh, ze zoeken mijn strategist, niet mij.



En dan zou ik je How to apply een stuk harder maken:



How to apply



We care about what you’ve actually done, not what you say you can do.



Please follow the application instructions below carefully.



Applications that are missing any of the requested items — including the Loom — will not be reviewed.



Send us:



A short introduction about who you are, your experience, and the DTC/eCommerce brands you’ve worked with.

At least 5 paid social ads you personally worked on. Tell us exactly what you were responsible for: research, strategy, angle, concept, script, editing, or creative direction.

Results from your work. Show us spend, revenue, ROAS, CPA, or other meaningful performance data connected to the creatives you worked on.



If you worked under an NDA, you can hide brand names and sensitive information. “I signed an NDA so I can’t show anything” is not enough.



A 3–5 minute Loom. Pick one DTC Meta ad you think is great and walk us through:

The hook and angle

The customer psychology behind it

Why you think it works

What you would test next

Your expected monthly salary in USD.



If you’re applying primarily as a video editor, please don’t apply. We already have editors on the team and this role is focused on research, strategy, concepts, performance marketing, and creative direction.



We’re not looking for someone who can simply make more ads.



We’re looking for someone who can figure out what we should make next, why we should make it, and what to do when it wins.
