title: Technical Account Manager (MSP) – Infrastructure, Cloud & Projects
description:
We are seeking a consultative and technically proficient Technical Account Manager (MSP) to serve as the primary technical advisor and relationship lead for a portfolio of business clients.

 

This role combines hands-on Level 2/3 project engineering, infrastructure modernization, and proactive technical account guidance. Instead of day-to-day help desk firefighting, your focus will be on assessing client environments, scoping and deploying infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations, and cybersecurity enhancements, and partnering with clients on practical technology improvement plans.

 

You will work directly with client leadership as well as Cloudavize’s local US account managers, project specialists, and service delivery teams to ensure technology recommendations are communicated clearly, scoped accurately, and deployed cleanly.

 

The ideal candidate moves effortlessly between conducting a technology alignment review, scoping a cloud migration, participating in a client account review, and executing complex network or systems configurations.

 

Key Responsibilities:



1. Technical Account Guidance & Client Advisory

* Client Account & Technology Reviews: Prepare and co-lead regular account and technology reviews with client stakeholders, presenting infrastructure health, risk findings, service performance trends, and recommended technical priorities.

* Technology Improvement Planning: Develop and maintain practical technology improvement plans covering hardware lifecycle management, cloud adoption, cybersecurity posture, and business continuity.

* Budgeting & Planning Support: Assist clients with technology lifecycle planning and cost estimations, helping them move away from reactive technical debt toward planned, structured IT investments.

* Security & Best Practice Alignment: Evaluate client environments against security baselines (CIS, NIST) and common compliance requirements (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2), outlining phased risk-remediation recommendations.

* Vendor & Solution Guidance: Act as a knowledgeable technical resource for clients evaluating third-party line-of-business software, connectivity providers, VoIP platforms, and productivity tools.



2. Project Engineering & Infrastructure Implementation

* Cloud & Modern Workplace Deployments: Implement migrations and rollouts across Microsoft 365 (tenant-to-tenant migrations, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive structure, Teams Phone, Intune MDM/MAM policies) and Azure cloud environments.

* Network & Perimeter Implementations: Stage, configure, and deploy network infrastructure, including firewalls, managed switches, VLAN segmentation, site-to-site VPNs, and wireless solutions (specializing in Cisco, Ubiquiti UniFi, and SD-WAN).

* System Modernization & Server Upgrades: Execute server virtualizations, Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID hybrid configurations, storage solutions (NAS/SAN), and operating system lifecycle upgrades.

* Backup & Disaster Recovery (BDR) Setup: Implement and validate immutable backup architectures, failover replication routines, and business continuity runbooks.

* Security Tooling Rollouts: Deploy and configure centralized endpoint security tools (EDR/MDR platforms), multi-factor authentication (MFA/SSO), mail hygiene systems, and automated patch management frameworks.

* Technical Quality & Cutover Execution: Conduct pre-implementation staging, rigorous cutover execution, and post-project validation to ensure minimal downtime and clean operational transitions.



3. Cross-Functional Account & Service Collaboration

* Partner with Local US Account Managers: Collaborate on account strategies, upcoming technology refreshes, client relationship health, and proposal generation. Translate technical findings into clear, value-driven project proposals.

* Collaborate with Project Teams: Work closely with Project Specialists to scope statements of work (SOWs), estimate engineering labor hours, identify technical dependencies, and hit project milestones on time.

* Coordinate with Service Delivery Teams: Ensure clean, structured handoffs of completed project implementations to the support team, providing updated architectural diagrams, network documentation (via IT Glue), and standard operating procedures.

* Internal Alignment & Continuous Improvement: Participate in regular service and account review meetings to identify systemic environment trends, technical debt, and lifecycle replacement priorities across assigned client accounts.

 

What Success Looks Like



* Trusted Technical Relationship: Client stakeholders view you as a dependable technical resource who understands their environment, communicates clearly, and possesses the hands-on credibility to execute recommendations.

* Flawless Project Delivery: Cloud migrations, network rollouts, and infrastructure projects are completed on schedule, within scope, and with minimal business disruption.

* Clean Operational Handoffs: Service Delivery teams receive comprehensive documentation and runbooks following project deployments, resulting in low post-cutover ticket volumes.

* Documented & Adopted Improvement Plans: Clients actively approve and prioritize your technical recommendations, steadily increasing their operational efficiency and security posture.

* High Client CSAT & Retention: Strong cross-functional alignment with account managers and service delivery leads to exceptional client satisfaction and long-term partnership growth.

 

Qualifications

Required

* Experience: 3–6+ years of progressive experience in an MSP, IT consulting firm, systems engineering, or technical services environment with demonstrable experience in hands-on project implementation and infrastructure upgrades.

* Consultative Communication: Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to converse with business leadership and present technical concepts in clear, business-driven language.

* Engineering Proficiency: Hands-on experience implementing solutions across Microsoft 365, Azure / Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Server, enterprise networking (Cisco, Ubiquiti, firewalls, VLANs, VPNs), and BDR platforms.

* Cross-Team Coordination: Proven ability to collaborate effectively with account managers, project coordinators, and support engineers in a fast-paced environment.

* Shift Readiness: Comfortable and capable of working a permanent US business hours schedule (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST / overnight in the Philippines).

* Location & Setup: Must be based in the NCR or Luzon area of the Philippines with a reliable home-office setup (high-speed internet and power backup).



Preferred

* Previous experience in a client-facing Technical Account Manager (TAM), Systems Engineer, or Senior Project Engineer role within an MSP.

* Experience preparing for and participating in client technology reviews or business reviews.

* Hands-on familiarity with MSP tools (PSA/RMM platforms, IT documentation tools like IT Glue).

* Relevant industry certifications such as Microsoft Certified (e.g., MS-102, AZ-104), Cisco (CCNA), CompTIA (Network+, Security+), or ITIL Foundation.

* Familiarity with common IT security frameworks and compliance standards (NIST, CIS, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2).

 

Why Join Cloudavize?



Work directly with US business leaders and help implement practical, high-impact technology solutions.

* Combine client-facing technical advisory with hands-on infrastructure engineering projects.

* Collaborate with a supportive US and global team of account managers, project specialists, and service delivery engineers.

* Clear career development pathways toward Senior Technical Account Management, Solutions Architecture, or Engineering Leadership.

 

What Sets Us Apart?



* We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally:

* Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

* Continuous Learning: We invest in your professional growth with company-paid certifications and technical training.

* Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input, respects your expertise, and supports your success.

* Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of working remotely from home while delivering high-value, impactful projects.

 

How to Apply



If you are a consultative, technically strong IT professional who enjoys leading strategic client conversations and executing modern infrastructure projects, apply now!

1. Subject Line Requirement: Submit your application and include the numbers (2028) in your
 subject line. This helps us ensure you have read the complete job post.

2. Resume/CV: Attach your updated CV with complete tenureship details (or provide a direct link to your CV). Applications submitted without a CV will not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you.

 when to keep a conversation casual versus when to guide it toward a next step?

Selected candidates will receive a short paid engagement exercise using real examples so we can evaluate comment quality, DM tone, conversation flow, and judgment.

title: SEO & SEM Specialist
description:
SEO & SEM Specialist



Location: Remote, working with a Singapore-based team  



Employment type: Full-time, 44 hours per week / 176 hours per month  



Working hours: Monday to Friday, 1:00pm to 9:00pm Singapore time  



Reporting to: Senior SEO Manager and CEO  



Experience required: 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience. Singapore education, tuition or local-service experience is strongly preferred.



About Achievers Dream

- Achievers Dream is a Singapore Chemistry and Science tuition specialist. The centre supports Primary Science students and students taking O-Level, IP and JC H1/H2 Chemistry, with centres at Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan. Its growth focus is clear: help more parents discover the right programme, book a diagnostic consultation or trial, and receive a thoughtful follow-up experience.



Role overview

- The SEO & SEM Specialist will own the search roadmap for Achievers Dream. This is a hands-on role covering technical SEO, local SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), content optimisation, Google Ads, landing-page conversion and performance reporting.



You will work closely with the management, content and web teams to make sure Achievers Dream is visible when Singapore parents search for Primary Science tuition, PSLE Science tuition, O-Level Chemistry tuition, JC H2 Chemistry tuition, Chemistry practical tuition and local tuition options near its centres.



The role is not just about traffic or clicks. It is about building a reliable search engine that produces qualified parent enquiries, trial bookings and measurable learning-programme demand.



What you will do



SEO strategy and execution

- Build and maintain an SEO roadmap for Achievers Dream's core programmes: Primary Science, PSLE Science, Lower Secondary Science, O-Level Chemistry, IP Chemistry, JC H1/H2 Chemistry and Chemistry practical lessons.

- Carry out keyword research, search-intent mapping and competitor analysis for the Singapore tuition market.

- Optimise service pages, location pages, resource hubs, blog content, titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and calls to action.

- Improve local SEO visibility for Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan, including Google Business Profile hygiene, location-page content and review signals.

- Work with the web team on technical SEO: crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, redirects, canonicals, structured data, mobile UX and site migrations.

- Build content briefs that help parents and students, while improving eligibility for search results and AI-assisted search experiences.

- Own GEO and AEO improvements so Achievers Dream is easier to understand, cite and recommend across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other answer engines, using clear entity information, helpful FAQs, structured content and accurate on-page proof.

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, indexed pages, technical issues and AI-search visibility; translate findings into a prioritised monthly action plan.



Google Ads and paid-search performance

- Build, manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns for Achievers Dream's programmes and locations.

- Structure campaigns by intent and level, for example: Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC H2 Chemistry, Chemistry Lab and local branch terms.

- Write and test search ads, assets, landing-page messages, audience signals, keyword match types and negative-keyword lists.

- Improve qualified leads by monitoring search terms, conversion quality, cost per lead, cost per booked trial and campaign-level performance.

- Run disciplined A/B tests across ads, landing pages, offers,- forms, calls to action and bidding strategies.

- Coordinate retargeting and paid social support where it is part of the approved campaign plan.

- Protect budget quality by excluding irrelevant searches such as free notes, tutor jobs, answer keys and non-target education levels where appropriate.



Analytics, reporting and conversion tracking

- Maintain reliable tracking across Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and lead or trial-booking forms.

- Define and report the conversion journey from click to enquiry, booked trial, attendance and enrolment where CRM data is available.

- Build a simple monthly dashboard for management covering organic visibility, paid spend, qualified enquiries, cost per lead, conversion rate, booked trials and key actions taken.

- Diagnose drops or anomalies before making recommendations; clearly distinguish confirmed first-party results from platform estimates.

- Use Ahrefs, Google Ads Keyword Planner, Google Search Console, GA4, Looker Studio and crawling tools to guide decisions.



Collaboration and ownership

- Work directly with management, teachers, content writers and developers to turn search insights into better pages, campaigns and parent journeys.

- Maintain a clear backlog of SEO, SEM, content and technical actions, including owner, priority, expected impact and validation method.

- Keep up with Google Ads policy changes, search algorithm updates, local-search behaviour and AI-assisted search trends.

- Bring practical recommendations, not just reports. Explain what should change, why it matters, who owns it and how success will be measured.



What we are looking for



Required

- 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience.

- Proven ability to manage search campaigns that generate leads, not just clicks.

- Strong technical SEO knowledge: site architecture, redirects, canonicals, indexation, page speed, Core Web Vitals, schema and internal linking.

- Strong Google Ads experience across search campaigns, keyword strategy, bidding, search-term analysis, conversion tracking and landing-page optimisation.

- Comfort using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Ahrefs, Looker Studio and spreadsheet-based analysis.

- Strong written English and the ability to write clear, parent-friendly search ads, briefs and reporting summaries.

- Analytical discipline: can explain the difference between a ranking, a click, an enquiry, a booked trial and an enrolled student.

- Organised, proactive and comfortable working independently in a remote team.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in Singapore local SEO, education, tuition, enrichment, healthcare or another parent-led local-service market.

- Experience optimising Google Business Profiles and multi-location local search.

- Experience working with WordPress, Astro or another modern CMS.

- Familiarity with CRM or lead-management workflows and offline conversion tracking.

- Experience producing or briefing educational content for Primary, PSLE, O-Level or JC audiences.

- Experience with GEO, AEO, AI-search visibility, entity optimisation or structured content for answer engines.



First 90 days

| Period | Focus | Expected output |

| Days 1 to 30 | Audit and foundation | Access and tracking review, SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads audit, keyword map, priority opportunity list, lead-quality baseline and 90-day execution plan. |

| Days 31 to 60 | Launch and optimise | Rebuilt or improved campaign structure, negative-keyword controls, priority landing-page improvements, local SEO actions and first content or technical tickets shipped. |

| Days 61 to 90 | Scale what works | Documented test learnings, conversion-quality review, a prioritised next-quarter roadmap and a management dashboard with agreed reporting definitions. |



KPIs for success



KPIs will be agreed after access, tracking and baseline data are verified. Likely measures include:

- Growth in qualified parent enquiries and booked trials from organic and paid search.

- Improvement in cost per qualified lead and cost per booked trial, where tracking is reliable.

- Visibility and ranking progress for agreed commercial keywords across Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC Chemistry and local branch terms.

- Organic clicks, impressions and conversion contribution from Google Search Console and GA4.

- Google Ads search-term quality, click-through rate, conversion rate and budget efficiency.

- Completion of agreed technical, content and landing-page priorities.

- Clear monthly reporting with recommendations, owners and follow-up actions.



Application process



Before submitting your resume, please include a concise 90-day draft plan for how you would improve Achievers Dream's SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads performance. This can be a one- to two-page document. We are looking for clear priorities, practical actions and how you would measure progress, not a generic proposal.



Please submit:



1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

2. Your 90-day draft plan, submitted together with your resume.

3. A short summary of one SEO project and one Google Ads project you personally improved.

4. A sample dashboard, report or case study, with sensitive client data removed.

5. A short response to this question: How would you approach improving qualified trial bookings for a Singapore Primary Science and Chemistry tuition centre in your first 90 days?



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid practical assessment based on an anonymised Achievers Dream landing page or Google Ads account scenario.

title: Marketing Coordinator | Content, SEO, Email & Social Media
description:
We’re looking for an A-grade Marketing Coordinator to join a growing Australian service business.



This is not a paid ads role.



We’re looking for someone who is organised, creative, proactive and capable of taking marketing ideas and turning them into consistent, high-quality execution.



You’ll work directly with the founder and help manage marketing across Simple Shine Window Services, as well as assist with the growth of the founder’s personal brand.



You won’t be expected to develop the entire marketing strategy yourself. We already have plenty of ideas.



We need someone who can help us organise them, improve them and, most importantly, execute them consistently.



What You’ll Be Doing

- Plan and create monthly
 marketing campaigns

- Develop seasonal campaigns and promotions

- Write and schedule Google Business Profile content

- Create LinkedIn posts and other organic social content

- Generate new content ideas for Simple Shine

- Write SEO-focused website articles and content

- Update and improve existing website content for SEO

- Repurpose existing content across multiple platforms

- Assist with YouTube content planning and ideation

- Edit straightforward talking-head YouTube videos

- Create YouTube titles, descriptions, thumbnails and supporting content

- Assist with the founder’s personal brand content

- Maintain our marketing and content calendar

- Keep the founder accountable to filming and content deadlines

- Track marketing performance and provide simple reporting

- Monitor paid advertising performance and report on results

- Identify new marketing opportunities and bring ideas to the table



Who We’re Looking For



You’re someone who gets things done.



You don’t need to be the world’s best copywriter, SEO expert, designer and video editor all rolled into one.



But you should be competent across multiple areas of digital marketing and great at using modern tools to produce quality work efficiently.



You should have:



- Previous digital marketing experience

- Strong written English

- Excellent organisation and attention to detail

- Experience with
 marketing

- Experience creating organic social media content

- A good understanding of SEO and content marketing

- Basic to intermediate video editing skills

- Experience with YouTube content is highly regarded

- Understanding of Google Business Profile

- Ability to interpret basic marketing analytics

- Confidence using AI tools to improve productivity

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

- A proactive mindset



Most importantly, we want someone who takes ownership.



If something is due Friday, we shouldn’t need to remember it on Friday.



You should be the person reminding us.



What The Role Looks Like



You’ll work closely with the founder.



We’ll provide the strategy, business knowledge, stories, footage and ideas.



Your job is to help turn those ideas into consistent marketing execution.



For example:



Cam says: “Spring is coming up. We should run something around spring window cleaning.”



You take that idea and turn it into:



- An
 campaign

- A Google Business Profile post

- LinkedIn content

- Social media content

- Supporting website or SEO content where appropriate

- A clear schedule for getting everything published



You then bring it back for approval and make sure it gets done.



That’s the type of person we’re looking for.



About Simple Shine:



Simple Shine Window Services is a growing exterior cleaning company based in Adelaide, Australia.



We’re building a business known for professionalism, great service and old-school customer service.



We have ambitious growth plans and are building a team of high-performing people who want to grow with the company.



For the right person, this role has the opportunity to grow significantly as the business grows.



If you would like to apply for this position, simply
 me at 
 with the word "SIMPLE" as the subject line with a little bit about yourself and why you'd be a great fit for this role.

title: Google Ads & Shopping Specialist – E-Commerce / Shopify
description:
Esszett Luxury is a German e-commerce company specializing in furniture, lighting, home accessories and lifestyle products.



We are currently building our own long-term in-house e-commerce and marketing team and are looking for an experienced Google Ads & Shopping Specialist.



This is not an agency position.



You will become part of our internal team and focus on Esszett only.



Our goal is not simply to generate more revenue. We want to build a profitable and scalable Google Ads strategy based on product performance, margins and real business results.



Your Main Responsibilities



Your main focus will be Google Ads and Google Shopping.



You will be responsible for:



Google Shopping campaigns

Performance Max campaigns

Google Search campaigns

Remarketing

Campaign structure and optimization

Budget allocation

Bid strategy optimization

Product-level performance analysis

Identifying profitable and unprofitable products

Scaling profitable campaigns

Reducing wasted advertising spend

Google Merchant Center

Product feed optimization

Merchant Center error monitoring and troubleshooting

Product exclusions

Custom Labels

Product segmentation

Campaign reporting and performance analysis

Feed Management



Experience with Channable is highly preferred.



You should ideally be comfortable with:



Feed rules

Product title optimization

Category mapping

Custom Labels

Product exclusions

Product segmentation

Google Shopping feeds

Feed troubleshooting

Different feed strategies based on product performance



If you have strong experience with other professional feed management tools such as DataFeedWatch, Feedonomics, Productsup or similar platforms, we are also interested in hearing from you.



You should be willing and able to learn Channable quickly if you have not used it before.



Google Merchant Center



Strong Google Merchant Center experience is important.



You should understand:



Product disapprovals

Feed errors

Product attributes

GTIN / MPN / Brand data

Product titles

Product categories

Shopping eligibility

Merchant Center diagnostics

Feed quality optimization

Profitability Is Very Important



We do not want someone who only looks at ROAS.



Our product catalogue contains products and brands with different margins.



You should understand that a product with a 30% margin requires a completely different advertising strategy than a product with a 50% margin.



You should be comfortable working with:



ROAS

CAC

Conversion Rate

Cost per Purchase

Revenue

Product margins

Contribution margin

Profitability after advertising costs



You should be able to identify which products should receive more advertising budget and which products should be reduced or excluded.



Tracking & Analytics



You should have practical experience with:



Google Analytics 4

Google Tag Manager

Google Ads Conversion Tracking

Shopify analytics

Tracking troubleshooting



You should be able to identify whether tracking is working correctly and recognize when campaign data may be inaccurate.



Shopify Experience



Experience with Shopify e-commerce stores is strongly preferred.



You will work closely with our internal Shopify/CRO specialist, product team and graphic designer.



For example:



You identify a product with strong potential but weak conversion.



You can then work directly with our:



Shopify/CRO Specialist

Graphic Designer

Product Listing Team



to improve the product page, creatives or product information.



Our Internal Team



You will work with:



E-Commerce Team Lead

Product Listing Specialists

Creative Designer

Shopify CRO & UX Specialist



This allows us to implement improvements quickly without relying on an external agency.



What We Are Looking For



You should have strong hands-on experience with:



Google Ads

Google Shopping

Performance Max

Google Merchant Center

E-commerce advertising

Shopify

Product feeds

Campaign optimization

Analytics and tracking



Experience with the German or European e-commerce market is highly preferred.



Experience with Germany, Austria or Switzerland would be a major advantage.



Important



We are not looking for someone who simply follows Google's automated recommendations.



We are looking for someone who can independently analyze an e-commerce business and make intelligent decisions based on profitability.



You should be able to explain:



Why a campaign is performing poorly

Which products are wasting advertising budget

Which products should be scaled

How the product feed should be improved

How campaigns should be segmented

How advertising can become more profitable

Working Hours

Approximately 40 hours per week

Monday to Friday

Remote

Long-term position

Focused on Esszett only



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of our internal e-commerce team and deeply understand our products, customers and business.



Compensation



$7–$10 per hour



Depending on experience and qualifications.



How to Apply



If you are interested, please contact:







Please include:



Your CV

Your Google Ads experience

Your Google Shopping / Performance Max experience

Your Google Merchant Center experience

Your experience with Channable or other feed management tools

Examples of e-commerce accounts or stores you have worked with

Your Shopify experience

Your expected hourly rate

Your availability



Please also answer the following question in your application:



Imagine a Shopify store has several thousand products with different margins and very high Google Ads costs. How would you analyze the account and d
 which products should receive more budget, less budget or be excluded from advertising?



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Shopify CRO & UX Specialist – E-Commerce
description:
Esszett Luxury is a growing German e-commerce company specializing in furniture, lighting, home accessories and lifestyle products.



We are currently expanding our own in-house e-commerce team in the Philippines and are looking for an experienced Shopify CRO & UX Specialist.



Your job will be to continuously improve our Shopify store, its design, usability and conversion rate.



This is a long-term position where you will focus on Esszett only.



Important: This Is a Hands-On Position



We are not looking for a CRO consultant who only analyzes websites and gives recommendations.



You must be able to implement your own recommendations directly in Shopify.



For example:



If you identify that a product page should be redesigned, you should be able to build and implement the improved version yourself.



Your Responsibilities



You will continuously improve and develop our Shopify store, including:



Shopify theme customization

Product page optimization

Collection page optimization

Homepage improvements

Landing page creation

Mobile optimization

Navigation improvements

Search and filter optimization

Cart optimization

Conversion Rate Optimization

UX improvements

Cross-selling

Upselling

Trust elements

Product information sections

USP sections

Improving calls-to-action

Creating and modifying Shopify sections

Implementing new layouts and designs

Installing and configuring Shopify apps

Improving page speed

Identifying conversion problems

Analyzing customer behavior

Preparing and implementing A/B tests

Continuous testing and improvement of the store

Technical Skills



You should have good hands-on experience with:



Shopify

Shopify Themes

Shopify Liquid

HTML

CSS

Basic JavaScript

Responsive / mobile design



You do not need to be a senior software developer, but you must be comfortable modifying Shopify themes and implementing design and CRO changes yourself.



CRO Experience



You should understand:



Conversion Rate Optimization

E-commerce UX

Product page optimization

Mobile-first design

Customer journeys

Trust building

Cart and checkout optimization

Upselling and cross-selling

Landing page optimization

A/B testing

Heatmaps and customer behavior analysis



Experience with tools such as Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar or similar CRO tools is a plus.



Design Collaboration



You do not need to create all graphics yourself.



We already have an internal graphic designer who creates:



Product images

USP images

Banners

Advertising creatives

Visual elements



You will work closely with our designer.



For example, you may request:



“Please create three USP graphics for this product page.”



Our designer creates them, and you implement them in Shopify and optimize the page around them.



Working With Our Marketing Team



You will also work closely with our Performance Marketing & Feed Manager.



For example:



Paid traffic shows a high number of visitors but a low conversion rate.



Your job will be to analyze the relevant product or landing page, identify possible problems, implement improvements and measure the results.



We want to continuously improve:



Traffic → Product Page → Cart → Purchase



What We Are Looking For



Ideally, you have experience with:



Shopify e-commerce stores

CRO

Shopify theme development

UX/UI

Large product catalogues

Furniture, interior, lifestyle or premium e-commerce



Experience with German or European e-commerce stores is highly preferred.



Experience with the DACH market is a major advantage.



Working Hours



Initially approximately:



20–30 hours per week



If the cooperation works well and there is enough work, the position can grow further.



Monday to Friday

Remote

Philippines

Long-term cooperation

Compensation



Depending on your experience:



€6–€9 per hour



For a very experienced Shopify CRO specialist with excellent technical skills, we are open to discussing a higher rate.



How to Apply



If you are interested, please contact us at:







Please send:



Your CV

Your Shopify experience

Examples of Shopify stores you have worked on

Before/after examples of CRO improvements if available

Your portfolio

Information about your Liquid / HTML / CSS experience

Your expected hourly rate

Your availability



Please also briefly explain one Shopify CRO project where you personally identified a conversion problem and implemented the solution yourself.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Short-Term Rental Operations & Marketing VA (UK property business, long term role)
description:
Who we are



We are Cozy Quarters Property Management, a serviced accommodation business in the North East of England. Our website is 
. Please look at it before you apply, because we will ask you about it.



We manage properties across Teesside and County Durham. Some are holiday cottages for short breaks. Some are houses where contractors and project teams stay for weeks or months. The owner is Susie, and she runs the business herself.



You would be our first team member. This is not a job where you are one of fifty VAs. You will work directly with the owner and grow as the business grows.



What you will be doing



- Managing and updating our property adverts across Airbnb, 
, Google, our website and other platforms

- Working with the owner on pricing to attract more bookings and longer stays

- Managing and updating our channel manager, which is Uplisting

- Daily optimisation of listings and calendars, including last minute deals

- Answering guest messages quickly. Our response rate is inside an hour and usually inside ten minutes, and we need that to continue

- Looking after our social media posting and keeping our accounts active

- Supporting the director with admin and ad hoc projects

- Spotting problems, opportunities and things we could do better, and telling us



Hours and pay



27 hours a week, six days a week, including Sundays.

Five hours a day: four and a half working hours plus a 30 minute break.

11am to 4pm UK time, which is 6pm to 11pm in the Philippines. Please check that against your own clock before applying. From late October to March it becomes 7pm to midnight your time, because the UK clocks change.



550 US dollars per month, paid monthly. There is no 13th month payment. We are telling you now rather than letting you find out later.



We are looking for someone to stay with us for a minimum of three years and grow into more hours, more responsibility and more money as we grow. We do not pay poverty rates and we are not looking for the cheapest person.



This must be your only job during these hours.



What we are looking for



Essential:

- At least two years in short term rentals, serviced accommodation, hospitality or Airbnb and 

- Excellent written and spoken English. You will be writing to our guests and posting publicly

- Your own working computer, and ideally a backup

- Reliable power and internet. Tell us honestly how often your power goes out and what your backup is. We would far rather know now



Strongly preferred, and it will count in your favour:

- Uplisting experience. This is the channel manager we use. If you have used a different one, say which, and tell us how quickly you tend to pick up a new system

- Hands on pricing and optimisation experience. PriceLabs, Quibble, Wheelhouse or manual



And this matters just as much as the tools. We are scoring attitude and willingness to learn alongside experience, not after it. Someone who is genuinely interested in the business and wants to grow with it will beat someone with a longer list of software they have logged into. We would rather train the right person than inherit the wrong one.



Who we are looking for



- Highly organised and attentive to detail

- Intelligent and quick to learn

- A natural problem solver who thinks independently

- Reliable and driven to finish every task properly

- Polite, calm, professional and caring

- Comfortable taking responsibility and working without constant supervision



We treat people properly. Take your breaks, tell us when your power is out, tell us when something has gone wrong. We would much rather hear about a problem than find it ourselves. What we cannot work with is someone who waits to be told.



How to apply



Please submit ALL of the following. Incomplete applications will not be considered.



1. Your CV in PDF format

2. A recent internet speed test result

3. Two professional references, with name, your working relationship,
 address and mobile number

4. A photo of your home office setup, including your computer and any backup equipment

5. A one minute video telling us about yourself, your experience and why you would suit this role

6. Answers to the seven questions below



Answer the questions in your own words. Using AI in the job is completely fine, we use it every day ourselves. But in our last round several applicants sent near identical answers written by ChatGPT and all of them were rejected. We can tell. We would much rather read your own imperfect English than a perfect answer that is not yours.



1. Start your reply with the word CALENDAR so we know you read this properly.



2. In three sentences, tell us what Cozy Quarters does and who you think our guests are.



3. Which channel manager have you used, for how many properties, and for how long? Tell us about one time it went wrong, a sync failure, a double booking, a rate that did not push, and what you did about it. If you have never used one, tell us instead about a system you learned quickly and how you went about it.



4. One of our properties is empty for the next ten nights. What are your first three actions, in order? Do not tell us you would drop the price. We want to know what you do before that.



5. A guest messages to say the lock box code is not working and they cannot get in. It is the middle of the night in the UK and nobody here is awake. Walk us through exactly what you do, step by step, starting with your first message.



6. Is the computer in your photo yours, and how often does your power or internet go out?



7. Confirm you can work 6pm to 11pm your time, six days a week including Sundays, that you understand this is 11am to 4pm in the UK, and that this would be your only job.



Applications close Sunday 30 August. We will reply to everyone we shortlist within a few days. Thank you for reading this far.

title: Remote Rental Operations Manager — Miami Luxury Real Estate Team
description:
About the Role



Our Lead to Lease Team runs a tenant side transaction, luxury rental operation in Miami/Broward — high-end condos, demanding clients, caller, TC, marketing, and a bench of showing agents who need to be held accountable. We are building our foundation for Q4 and expanding across Florida in 2027. This is not property management. This is not bulk listings. We are in the business of moving deals, and every lead and every deal needs an owner, a next step, a deadline, and someone making sure it happens.



This role sits directly below the lead Real Estate Agent. You are the operational layer between the agent and the team. The agent sets direction and handles the high-value conversations. You make sure everything behind that runs clean: leads are moving, agents are following through, showings are confirmed, applications are in process, and nothing is sitting idle without a reason.



The rental business has its own workflow, its own pressure points, and its own failure modes. A generic manager who is good at attendance tracking and KPIs but has never worked a rental pipeline will not know where a deal is actually breaking. We need someone who understands — or can get up to speed fast on — how a lead becomes a showing, a showing becomes an application, an application becomes a CTL, and a CTL becomes a closed deal. And more importantly: who knows exactly where things fall apart along that path and how to fix it.



What You'll Do



Your job is simple to say and hard to execute: make sure every lead and every deal has an owner, a next step, a deadline, and accountability. That means:



- Monitor the full pipeline daily — lead response times, qualification status, showing coverage, application progress, transaction deadlines

- Run daily team check-ins: who owns what, what moved yesterday, what is stuck today

- Hold agents accountable for follow-through — if a showing agent goes quiet after a tour, that is your problem to solve

- Be the first answer for VAs — answer questions, correct output, escalate only what needs the agent

- Confirm every showing: access confirmed, tenant packet ready, agent briefed

- Manage the CRM — every lead in the right stage, every next action logged, no dead air

- Handle or escalate client communication issues before they become complaints

- Identify when something is a compliance or brokerage-level issue and flag it immediately

- Review applications, CTL paperwork, and transaction documents under agent direction

- Know at any moment where each active deal is stuck and who owns the next action (quickly)



What We're Looking For



This role requires both of the following — not one or the other:



Rental market experience — specifically in Miami luxury residential. You have worked in the rental space for a real estate agent: luxury condos, urban high-rises, HOA-managed buildings. You know what a CTL is, what RentSpree is, what an HOA approval process looks like, and what it means to move fast in a competitive lease situation. You understand that our clients are making high-stakes decisions and handle them accordingly. Property management, manufactured housing, suburban leasing, or bulk portfolio experience does not apply here.



People management experience. You have been responsible for whether other people got their work done — not just your own tasks. You have held a VA or showing agent accountable, run a team call, corrected someone's work, and followed through until it was right. You are comfortable owning a meeting and you do not disappear into the background when someone needs to be held to a commitment.



Additional requirements:



- You can look at a pipeline and immediately identify where a deal is stuck and who owns the next action

- You write clearly and professionally — no sloppy grammar in your own messages or documents

- You are proactive — you surface problems before they become emergencies

- CRM experience required (GoHighLevel preferred), Google Workspace, calendar tools

- You understand that this role reports directly to a licensed Real Estate Agent. This is a strong #2 position, not an autonomous executive role. You lead the team beneath you and execute.



You are NOT a fit if:



Your rental experience is outside of Miami luxury residential (manufactured housing, suburban PM, bulk portfolios)

Your background is purely execution — data entry, appointment setting — with no history of managing other people's work

You avoid team calls or prefer to stay in the background

You have changed jobs every 6 months

You expect commission or per-deal pay



Application Question (Required — answer in your message or your application will not be reviewed)



Tell us about a time a deal or lead fell through the cracks on your team. What stage was it in, why did it happen, and what did you do about it?



To Apply



Send your resume, your answer to the application question, your availability, and your target monthly rate. To be considered reach out to Vincent directly on WhatsApp 
and send a short note here so he can review your profile. If you do not follow this you will not get a message back.

title: Content Writer & Community Manager – Reddit, Quora, Medium & LinkedIn
description:
ABOUT US



Istanbul Airport AssistME is an airport concierge and ground assistance provider serving passengers travelling through Istanbul Airport (IST).



Our team has been providing passenger assistance services since 2018, including Meet & Assist, Fast Track, porter, lounge, buggy and airport transfer coordination.



We are looking for a reliable and intelligent English Content Writer & Community Manager for a long-term position.



This is not a simple copy-and-paste posting job. You will be responsible for researching, writing, publishing and managing original content across four platforms:



• Reddit

• Quora

• Medium

• LinkedIn



ROLE DETAILS



• Part-time: approximately 20 hours per week

• Remote position

• Flexible working hours

• Long-term opportunity

• Possibility of increased hours based on performance



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Reddit



• Find relevant discussions about Istanbul Airport, airport greeting services,  transfers, flight connections, baggage, Fast Track and passenger assistance

• Write useful and ***natural comments*** that genuinely answer the passenger’s question

• Create informative Reddit posts without sounding promotional

• Respond to comments and follow-up questions

• Follow the rules of each subreddit

• Clearly disclose your relationship with our company whenever our services are mentioned

• Never pretend to be a customer or publish fake recommendations



Quora



• Find relevant airport and travel questions

• Research and write clear, accurate and helpful answers

• Manage the company’s Quora Business Profile

• Respond to comments and additional questions

• Include our company or website only when it is genuinely relevant



Medium



• Research and write two original airport-related articles per week

• Create useful passenger guides about Istanbul Airport, transfers, baggage, Meet & Assist, Fast Track, families, elderly passengers and complicated connections

• Format and publish the articles on Medium

• Add headings, images, sources and relevant website links

• Update previously published articles when airport information changes



LinkedIn



• Open & Manage the company’s LinkedIn page

• Write and publish three professional posts per week

• Create content about airport services, passenger experience, company updates and B2B partnerships

• Respond to relevant comments and messages

• Keep the company profile complete and up to date



CONTENT RESEARCH



You will create the content yourself. We will not provide finished articles or posts.



You must:



• Research each subject before writing

• Prioritize official airport, airline, government and other trustworthy sources

• Check facts carefully before publishing

• Ask us before publishing any uncertain operational information

• Never invent terminal information, service availability, prices, meeting points or airport procedures

• Write every piece of content in natural, fluent English

• Adapt the content separately for each platform instead of copying the same text everywhere

• Maintain a weekly content calendar

• Keep a record of all published links



EXPECTED WEEKLY OUTPUT



• Reddit: 7–8 original posts and regular helpful comments

• Quora: 5–7 detailed answers

• Medium: 3-4 original articles

• LinkedIn: 5 professional posts

• Daily monitoring of comments and replies

• Weekly report containing published links, basic performance figures and next week’s content plan



IMPORTANT CONTENT RULES



We do not allow:



• Fake customer reviews or recommendations

• Pretending to be an independent customer

• Spam comments or mass link posting

• Copying content from other websites

• Publishing the same content across every platform

• Generic, unedited AI-generated content

• Invented airport information

• Buying followers, votes, comments or backlinks

• Creating additional accounts without permission



AI tools may be used to assist with research and drafting, but every piece must be fact-checked, rewritten and reviewed by you before publication.



REQUIREMENTS



• Excellent written English

• Strong online research and fact-checking skills

• Experience writing articles, answers or social media content

• Familiarity with Reddit culture and community rules

• Ability to write helpful content without making it sound like an advertisement

• Good judgment and attention to detail

• Ability to work independently and meet weekly deadlines

• Experience with Quora, Medium or LinkedIn is an advantage

• Travel, aviation or hospitality experience is an advantage



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the word “ISTANBUL” so we know you read the complete job description...



Include:

5. Your expected monthly salary for 20 hours per week

6. Your internet speed and usual working hours

“Do I need to collect and re-check my baggage if I have separate flight tickets at Istanbul Airport?”



We are looking for someone who writes clearly, checks facts carefully and understands the difference between genuinely helping travellers and promoting a company.

title: Static Ad Creative Producer — E-commerce / Meta Ads (AI image tools)
description:
Static Ad Creative Producer — E-commerce / Meta Ads (AI image tools)



JOB TYPE

Full-time (40 hrs/week) · Long-term · Work from home



SALARY

$400 – $700 USD/month depending on experience, paid monthly. Paid trial project first (see "How to apply"). Raise after 90 days based on results, plus a bonus every time one of your creatives becomes a winner we scale.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

I run several e-commerce brands (supplements and DTC products) and I currently produce all the static ads for Meta myself. I have a documented, proven system for it — I need one person to take it over completely and run it every day.



This is NOT a "design something pretty" job. It is a production job with a system: research what already works, rebuild it for our product, ship volume, keep everything organized so we can tell exactly which creative made money.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

Research winning ads. Go through ad libraries and spy tools, find the static ads that big brands are running the longest (long-running = profitable). Save them into our swipe library.

Rebuild them for our products. When we clone a winning ad, the image is copied faithfully — same composition, same framing, same energy. Only the text, the product and the proof numbers change. "Close enough" is not close enough here.

Produce new creatives from our blueprint system. We work with detailed image prompts (AI generation: Nano Banana / similar tools). You generate, you check, you regenerate until it is right.

Always 1080×1080. Every single static, no exception, even when the reference ad is vertical — you recompose the layout inside the square. You verify the exported dimensions before delivery.

Write the on-image copy following our rules: name the exact customer and her/his problem so the person recognizes themselves in one second; benefit + the reason it works, never a vague slogan; a banned-words list to respect so the ad account never gets flagged.

Tag every creative with 5 labels: Concept (the visual format) × Angle × Sub-avatar × Hook × Awareness level. This is how we know which combination wins, so it must never be skipped.

Keep the asset registry. Every image gets a unique name, gets archived, and gets logged with the prompt that produced it. We must be able to find and relaunch any winner months later without regenerating it.

Deliver a review page at the end of each batch: every visual displayed large, with its tags, ready for me to approve in a few minutes.

VOLUME WE EXPECT

30 to 60 finished statics per week once you are trained (first weeks will be slower — that is normal and expected).



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE

Solid written English. You will be writing headlines that must sound native and punchy. This is the #1 filter.

Real experience with Photoshop or Canva or Figma — you can rebuild a layout, match a font, place text cleanly, export exact dimensions.

You have used AI image generation tools (Midjourney, Nano Banana, Firefly, Stable Diffusion or similar) and you know that the first output is rarely the good one.

Extremely organized. File naming, folders, spreadsheets/registries — this part of the job is as important as the design part.

You follow a written process exactly. When the process says "always 1080×1080" or "never use this word", there is no interpretation.

Reliable daily communication, and you tell me when something is blocked instead of going silent.

NICE TO HAVE (not required)

You have worked on Meta /
 ads before and know what gets an account restricted.

You understand direct response marketing (hooks, angles, awareness levels) — or you are hungry to learn it. I will train you on our system.

Basic video editing.

IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

Some of the brands are in the health and women's wellness space, including intimacy/sexual wellness products. The work is never explicit, but if that topic is not something you are comfortable working on every day, this role is not for you and that is completely fine.



WHY THIS JOB IS GOOD

The system already exists and is proven — you are not inventing anything from zero, you are running a machine.

Direct work with the owner, no middle manager, fast decisions.

Clear success metric: creatives that make sales. When you produce winners, you earn more.

Long-term position. I am looking for someone to keep for years, not for one project.

HOW TO APPLY

Applications that ignore these steps are deleted without reading — please follow them exactly.



Start your message with the word SQUARE so I know you read the whole post.

Send a portfolio or 3–5 examples of ads, banners or graphics you have made. Say clearly which parts you did yourself.

Answer in 2–3 sentences: when you copy an existing winning ad for a different product, what exactly should change and what must stay the same?

Tell me which AI image tools you have used, and roughly how many images you have generated.

Tell me your monthly rate and how many hours per week you can commit.

Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial task (I will send you one reference ad to rebuild for one of our products, in 1080×1080, with 3 headline variations). Good trials get hired within a few days.

title: Finance Manager / Accounting Manager
description:
Facelove is a fast-growing DTC beauty brand in the US. We're direct-response first, the large majority of our revenue comes from paid acquisition, and every decision we make is measured against CAC, MER and contribution margin.

We're scaling quickly, and we're looking for a Head of Paid Media to own that growth: someone who has run serious spend before, knows what breaks at scale, and can build the system that gets us to the next level.



About the Role:



You'll own Facelove's finances: the close, the cash, the numbers everyone else makes decisions from.



This is a hands-on role, not a supervisory one. You'll do the reconciliations, build the models, and run the payment cycles yourself, while working alongside our external Dutch accountants on statutory filings. You'll report directly to the founder and COO.



The person who succeeds here is comfortable being the only finance person in the building. You'll set up the systems, then run them.



What you'll own





Full monthly close on a fixed calendar, with a close you can stand behind

Bank, payment processor and intercompany reconciliations

Chart of accounts, accrual policy, and the discipline to keep both clean as we scale

Documentation and audit trail good enough that a new person could pick it up

13-week rolling cash forecast, with paid media and inventory as the two variables that matter

Weekly cash position and runway, and early warning when something is drifting

Working capital: inventory purchase timing, supplier terms, processor payout cycles

Annual budget and quarterly reforecast, built with the founders and then held to

Unit economics and margin reporting

Contribution margin by channel, product and cohort, not just top-line P&L

The finance side of CAC, MER, AOV, LTV and payback, in partnership with paid media

Landed cost per unit and true gross margin, including freight, duties and 3PL fees

Calling out where we're losing money before it shows up in a quarterly number

Inventory accounting across manufacturing, freight and 3PL

COGS accuracy, standard cost maintenance, and variance analysis

Inventory reconciliation against 3PL reporting, including shrinkage and damages

Flagging stock and cash risk on reorders early enough to act on

Revenue recognition across Shopify and all payment methods

Processor reconciliation: fees, holds, reserves, payout timing

Refunds, chargebacks and disputes, tracked as a cost line with an owner

Subscription and repeat revenue reporting, if and as we build it

Monthly payment runs for a contractor-heavy team across multiple countries and currencies

Contractor documentation and compliance records, kept current rather than reconstructed

Accounts payable, vendor terms, and the discipline to pay correctly and on time

Working with HR on payroll verification, so hours, invoices and payments actually agree

Dutch statutory obligations for ODAQ B.V., managed with our external accountants

VAT filings and multi-currency treatment

US sales tax nexus and registrations as our footprint expands

Keeping us clean in every market we sell in, and telling us before a threshold becomes a problem

A monthly reporting pack a founder can read in ten minutes and trust

A weekly one-page view of cash, spend and margin

Ad hoc analysis that answers the question asked, with the assumptions visible



Skills Required: 



5+ years in accounting or finance, with at least 2 in ecommerce, DTC or consumer products

You have owned a monthly close yourself, not contributed to someone else's

Inventory and COGS accounting experience, including landed cost

Multi-currency and multi-entity experience, comfortable with FX and intercompany

Strong modelling ability in Excel or Google Sheets. You build the model, you don't just maintain someone else's tab

Fluency with Shopify or a comparable ecommerce platform, payment processors, and a cloud accounting system (Xero, QuickBooks, Exact or similar)

You can explain a variance to a non-finance founder without jargon and without hedging

Excellent written English, and the judgement to escalate things in writing before they become urgent



Strong plus



Experience with a Netherlands-registered entity, or comfort working with Dutch statutory requirements and external accountants

US sales tax nexus and multi-state registration experience

Beauty, skincare or supplements

High paid-media environments, where ad spend is the largest line and reconciles across four platforms

3PL and inventory planning exposure

CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA or local equivalent

You've been the first finance hire somewhere and built the function from a messy starting point



What we offer



- Real ownership of the most important function in the business, with a direct line to the founders

- Remote-first, async-friendly, results-measured

- A brand with genuine product-market fit and room to scale



CLICK THE LINK TO APPLY:

title: Marketing Technology & Web Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are a growing US-based healthcare organization looking for a hands-on Marketing Technology & Web Specialist to join our team full-time.



This person will be the primary technical resource for our marketing team. You will report directly to the CMO and be responsible for implementing and maintaining the technology behind our websites, landing pages, forms, tracking, attribution, and marketing integrations.



This is a hands-on role. We need someone who can take a request and actually implement it, whether that means modifying a Webflow form, building a landing page, fixing a tracking pixel, connecting a new marketing platform, configuring a subdomain, or troubleshooting why attribution data is missing.



You will also work directly with our vendors and other specialists when systems connect. For example, you may work with our call-tracking provider’s engineers to complete an integration, meet with our paid media team to troubleshoot conversion tracking, or work with our CRM & Automation Specialist to make sure lead data is passing correctly into our internal systems.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Websites, Forms & Landing Pages



* Maintain and update our Webflow website

* Build and modify pages, forms, fields, dropdowns, and other website elements

* Build, duplicate, and modify landing pages in Unbounce

* Implement technical and layout changes for conversion-rate tests

* Ensure pages and forms work properly across desktop and mobile

* Maintain existing designs and styling provided by our creative team

* Monitor and improve page performance and load speed

* Troubleshoot website and form issues



Marketing Tracking & Attribution



* Configure, test, and maintain Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, GA4, and other marketing tracking

* Manage our Google Tag Manager environment

* Audit and troubleshoot tags, triggers, variables, data layers, and tracking scripts

* Identify duplicate, conflicting, or broken tracking

* Verify that forms, phone calls, and other conversions are attributed to the correct sources and campaigns

* Troubleshoot discrepancies between advertising platforms and actual leads

* Make sure new pages, forms, and campaigns launch with the appropriate tracking in place



Call Tracking & Marketing Integrations



* Maintain the technical side of our WhatConverts call-tracking and attribution setup

* Manage Dynamic Number Insertion (DNI) and related tracking

* Connect and configure new marketing tools and integrations

* Work directly with software vendors and their technical teams when needed

* Implement required changes on our side of integrations

* Test integrations to verify that data is flowing correctly in both directions

* Troubleshoot UTMs, GCLIDs, lead IDs, webhooks, forms, and other attribution data



Experience with WhatConverts specifically is not required if you have experience with similar platforms such as CallRail and can learn new systems quickly.



Working With Our Other Specialists



You will work closely with our paid media team, creative agency, software vendors, and CRM & Automation Specialist.



We have a separate CRM & Automation Specialist responsible for ClickUp, Make, Zapier, lead routing, internal workflows, and backend automations. You will not be responsible for taking over that role.



Where the systems connect, you will work together. For example, if a Webflow form captures a UTM parameter but it does not appear correctly in our CRM, you may troubleshoot the website and tracking side while the CRM & Automation Specialist checks the backend automation and field mapping.



Similarly, our paid media partners manage Google Ads and Meta campaigns. You will not manage the campaigns themselves, but you will work with them to make sure the technical tracking supporting those campaigns is implemented and working correctly.



Our creative partners handle primary branding and graphic design. You should be able to implement and modify existing designs, but you do not need to be a graphic designer.



Must-Have Skills



* Webflow: Strong hands-on experience with Webflow, including forms, CMS, responsive layouts, styling, and modifying existing websites

* Google Tag Manager: Strong experience with tags, triggers, variables, custom events, data layers, Preview Mode, and debugging

* Conversion Tracking: Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting Google Ads, Meta Pixel, and GA4 tracking

* Technical Troubleshooting: Ability to investigate technical problems, identify the root cause, implement a solution, and verify that it works

* Marketing Integrations: Comfortable working with forms, webhooks, attribution data, tracking scripts, and connections between marketing platforms

* English Communication: Strong written and spoken English. You must be comfortable speaking directly with the CMO, vendors, developers, and other technical specialists



Strongly Preferred



* Unbounce

* JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

* Chrome DevTools or similar browser debugging tools

* Cloudflare and DNS management

* WhatConverts, CallRail, or other DNI/call-tracking platforms

* Experience with UTMs, GCLIDs, and marketing attribution

* API and webhook integrations

* Experience troubleshooting website-to-CRM data flows



What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is hands-on, technically curious, and takes ownership.



If the CMO asks you to modify a form, you should be able to make the change. If a tracking pixel is not working, you should be able to investigate it. If a new platform needs to be integrated, you should be able to implement the technical work on our side and work directly with the platform’s engineers when necessary.



You are not replacing our paid media team, CRM & Automation Specialist, or creative agency. You are the technical person on the marketing team who makes sure the technology they depend on works correctly.



How to Apply



Please include a brief 5–8 sentence answer to the following scenario in your application:



Imagine you are auditing our Google Ads tracking and suspect that our lead conversion tag is double-counting conversions, causing Google Ads to report more leads than we are actually receiving. Describe the exact step-by-step process you would use to determine whether duplicate conversions are actually firing on the website, what you would examine to identify the root cause, and how you would verify that the issue has been resolved.



Applications that do not answer the screening scenario will not be considered.

Call, text, and

title: Designer/
description:
Dear future creative partner!



We are looking for a Virtual Assistant with a strong eye for design and social media to help us create advertisements for Social Techniek Vacatures.



And to be clear: we are not looking for someone who only knows how to make things “look nice”.



We are looking for someone who understands social media, advertising and attention.



Someone who sees an ad and immediately thinks:



“I know how to make this stand out.”



Maybe you even have a small social media addiction. In this case, that’s actually a plus. ????



Are you the person we are looking for?



* You have experience creating social media designs and advertisements

* You are comfortable working in tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Figma or similar

* You understand what makes people stop scrolling

* You follow social media trends, formats, memes and creative advertising concepts

* You have a strong feeling for typography, composition and visual hierarchy

* You can take a rough idea or example and turn it into a strong finished design

* You are able to create multiple creative variations from one concept

* You understand that an advertisement needs to perform, not just look beautiful

* You work independently and communicate clearly

* You are open to feedback and like improving concepts together

* You enjoy experimenting with new creative ideas and AI tools



Experience with Meta Ads, recruitment marketing or performance marketing is a big plus.



A little more about Social Techniek Vacatures:



Social Techniek Vacatures helps technical companies in the Netherlands find new employees through social media.



Instead of waiting for candidates to search through job boards, we bring vacancies directly to them through platforms such as
 and Instagram.



We create the strategy, advertisements and campaigns, generate candidates and follow them up personally.



You will work closely with a small team consisting of:



* A Social Media Manager

* A Systems Manager

* A Recruiter

* Our Marketing Manager



You will mainly work together with our Marketing Manager, who has more than 10 years of experience running Meta advertising campaigns.



And this is important:



He loves creative advertising.



We don't want stiff corporate designs.



We don't want every vacancy advertisement to look like another boring recruitment template.



We like concepts that are fun, different, clever, relatable and sometimes a little weird.



One day we might create a WhatsApp-style advertisement.



The next day it could be a handwritten resignation letter stuck to a computer screen.



Or a meme, POV concept, comparison, fake notification or completely new idea we haven't tried before.



We test a lot.



And we are looking for someone who enjoys that process just as much as we do.



Your biggest responsibility will be helping us turn advertising ideas into strong designs.



That includes:



* Creating social media advertisements

* Designing different variations of winning concepts

* Turning rough ideas and references into polished creatives

* Thinking along about new creative concepts

* Adapting designs for different vacancies and clients

* Creating formats for
 and Instagram

* Keeping an eye on new design and social media trends

* Occasionally helping with other marketing visuals when needed



You don't need to come up with everything yourself.



We already create a lot of concepts internally.



But we do want a sparring partner.



Someone who doesn't just say:



“Okay, I will make it.”



But sometimes says:



“What if we try it like this instead?”



That's exactly the kind of person we are looking for.



We are informal, direct and ambitious.



We like people who take ownership, communicate openly and aren't afraid to share their opinion.

description:
